points.name: 一点儿/一个……都/也不/没……
points.pinyin: yìdiǎnr / yí ge ... dōu / yě bù / méi ...
points.explainEn: Use this pattern to say 'not at all' or 'not even one'.
points.structure: 主语 + 一 + 量词/一点儿 +（名词）+ 都/也 + 不/没 + 动词/形容词

examples.en: I am not tired at all.
examples.py: Wǒ yìdiǎnr yě bú lèi.

examples.en: He did not drink even one glass of water.
examples.py: Tā yì bēi shuǐ dōu méi hē.

examples.en: I do not know a single friend.
examples.py: Wǒ yí ge péngyou yě bú rènshi.

exercises.q: 他来中国三年了，一句中文也___会说。
exercises.body: 他来中国三年了，一句中文也___会说。
exercises.explain: “会”表示能力，一般否定用“不”，所以是“一句也不会说”；“没”不能直接放在“会”前面。
exercises.explainEn: 会 (can) is negated with 不, so it is 一句也不会说; 没 cannot go before 会.

exercises.q: 这个周末我太忙了，一个电影___。
exercises.body: 这个周末我太忙了，一个电影___。
exercises.explain: “一＋量词＋名词＋都/也”后面必须是否定，周末已经过去，所以用“都没看”。
exercises.explainEn: 一 + measure word + noun + 都/也 must be followed by a negative; the weekend is past, so 都没看.

exercises.q: 下面哪一句有错？
exercises.body: 下面哪一句有错？
options: 上个月他一次也不迟到过。
我对这个城市一点儿也不了解。
这个问题我一点儿也不明白。
exercises.explain: 说过去的经历要用“没……过”，不能用“不”：上个月他一次也没迟到过。
exercises.explainEn: For past experience use 没…过, not 不: 上个月他一次也没迟到过。

exercises.q: I am not worried at all.
exercises.body: I am not worried at all.

exercises.q: She did not buy even one book.
exercises.body: She did not buy even one book.

exercises.q: He does not understand any Chinese at all.
exercises.body: He does not understand any Chinese at all.

points.note: “一……也/都……”与否定词搭配；过去未发生多用“没”，一般否定多用“不”。
points.source: Discover China Student's Book Four (用户上传教材): Language in use
points.structureEn: Subject + 一 (yī) + Measure Word / 一点儿 (yìdiǎnr, any) + (Noun) + 都/也 (dōu/yě, even) + 不/没 (bù/méi, not) + Verb / Adjective
points.noteEn: "一……也/都……" is used together with a negative word: use 没 (méi) for something that did not happen in the past, and 不 (bù) for general negation.

points.name: 是……的（强调过去动作的细节）
points.explainEn: Use 是…的 to highlight the time, place, or way of a past action.
points.structure: 主语 + 是 + 时间/地点/方式 + 动词 +（宾语）+ 的

examples.en: I arrived yesterday.
examples.py: Wǒ shì zuótiān dào de.

examples.en: This ticket was bought online.
examples.py: Zhè zhāng piào shì wǎngshàng mǎi de.

examples.en: He came by train.
examples.py: Tā shì zuò huǒchē lái de.

exercises.q: 你的中文说得真好，你是在哪儿学___？
exercises.body: 你的中文说得真好，你是在哪儿学___？
exercises.explain: “是……的”强调已经发生的动作的地点，句末要用“的”，不能用“了”。
exercises.explainEn: 是……的 stresses where a past action happened and must end with 的, not 了.

exercises.q: 我是坐火车来北京的，___。
exercises.body: 我是坐火车来北京的，___。
exercises.explain: “是……的”说的是已经发生的事，人已经到了北京，所以后面只能说路上的情况；“才能到、还在买票、还没买到”都表示还没来。
exercises.explainEn: 是…的 talks about something that has already happened: he is already in Beijing, so only a remark about the trip fits; the others mean he hasn't come yet.

exercises.q: 下面哪一句有错？
exercises.body: 下面哪一句有错？
options: 我是去年九月来中国的。
这件衣服是在网上买的。
exercises.explain: “是……的”中间不能再用“了”：他是坐出租车来的。
exercises.explainEn: No 了 inside 是……的: 他是坐出租车来的。

exercises.q: I came by plane.
exercises.body: I came by plane.

exercises.q: She bought the book yesterday.
exercises.body: She bought the book yesterday.

exercises.q: We met at school.
exercises.body: We met at school.

points.note: 动作已发生；强调部分在“是”和“的”之间。
points.source: Discover China Student's Book Four (用户上传教材): Language in use
points.structureEn: Subject + 是 (shì) + Time / Place / How + Verb + (Object) + 的 (de)
points.noteEn: The action has already happened; the part you want to emphasize goes between 是 and 的.

points.name: 回/进/上/下 + 来/去（趋向补语）
points.pinyin: huí / jìn / shàng / xià + lái / qù
points.explainEn: Use 来 for movement toward the speaker and 去 for movement away.
points.structure: 动词 + 回/进/上/下 + 来/去

examples.en: He walked in toward us.
examples.py: Tā zǒu jìnlai le.

examples.en: Please bring the book up here.
examples.py: Qǐng bǎ shū ná shànglai.

examples.en: She ran down (away from us).
examples.py: Tā pǎo xiàqu le.

exercises.q: 我在楼上等你，你快走___吧。
exercises.body: 我在楼上等你，你快走___吧。
exercises.explain: 说话人在楼上，对方要向上、向说话人走，所以用“上来”；“上去”是离开说话人。
exercises.explainEn: The speaker is upstairs and the listener moves up toward him, so 上来; 上去 means moving away from the speaker.

exercises.q: 我在___，听到朋友叫我，就跑下去了。
exercises.body: 我在___，听到朋友叫我，就跑下去了。
exercises.explain: “跑下去”是从高处往低处走，所以人原来应该在楼上。
exercises.explainEn: 跑下去 means running from a higher place to a lower one, so the person must have been upstairs.

exercises.q: 下面哪一句有错？
exercises.body: 下面哪一句有错？
options: 请把桌子上的书拿下来。
exercises.explain: 表示处所的宾语要放在“来/去”前面：老师走进教室去了（或：走进了教室）。
exercises.explainEn: A place object goes before 来/去: 老师走进教室去了 (or 走进了教室).

exercises.q: Please walk back here.
exercises.body: Please walk back here.

exercises.q: He walked downstairs.
exercises.body: He walked downstairs.

exercises.q: Bring the bag inside.
exercises.body: Bring the bag inside.

points.note: 教材重点为复合趋向；方向以说话人的位置为参照。
points.source: Discover China Student's Book Four (用户上传教材): Language in use
points.structureEn: Verb + Direction (回 huí / 进 jìn / 上 shàng / 下 xià) + 来 (lái, toward) / 去 (qù, away)
points.noteEn: The textbook focuses on compound direction complements (like 走进来, 拿上去). The direction is judged from where the speaker is.

points.name: 连……都/也……
points.explainEn: Use 连…都/也… to mean 'even…', showing surprise or an extreme case.
points.structure: 连 + 特别的人/事 + 都/也 + 谓语

examples.en: He can even sing Chinese songs.
examples.py: Tā lián Zhōngwén gē dōu huì chàng.

examples.zh: 今天太忙了，我连午饭都没吃。
examples.en: I was so busy that I did not even eat lunch.
examples.py: Jīntiān tài máng le, wǒ lián wǔfàn dōu méi chī.

examples.zh: 连小孩子也知道这个字。
examples.en: Even a child knows this character.
examples.py: Lián xiǎo háizi yě zhīdào zhège zì.

exercises.q: 连他最好的朋友___不知道这件事。
exercises.body: 连他最好的朋友___不知道这件事。
exercises.explain: “连”后面要用“也”或“都”来呼应，表示连最不可能的人都不知道；“又、就、才”不能这样用。
exercises.explainEn: 连 must be matched by 也 or 都 to mean 'even'; 又, 就 and 才 cannot pair with it.

exercises.q: 这个汉字很常见，连___都认识。
exercises.body: 这个汉字很常见，连___都认识。
exercises.explain: “连”后面要放最不可能做到的人：连刚学中文的外国人都认识，才说明这个字常见；老师、专家认识很正常。
exercises.explainEn: 连 introduces the least likely case: if even beginners know it, the character is common; teachers or experts knowing it proves nothing.

exercises.q: 下面哪一句有错？
exercises.body: 下面哪一句有错？
options: 连他妈妈都不知道他去哪儿了。
exercises.explain: “连”后面一定要有“都/也”：他连早饭都没吃就走了。
exercises.explainEn: 连 needs 都/也 after it: 他连早饭都没吃就走了.

exercises.q: Even the teacher does not know.
exercises.body: Even the teacher does not know.

exercises.q: I did not even have time to rest.
exercises.a: 我连休息的时间都没有。
exercises.body: I did not even have time to rest.

exercises.q: She can even speak Japanese.
exercises.body: She can even speak Japanese.

points.note: “连”突出意外对象，“都/也”应出现；不是普通的“都”列举。
points.source: Discover China Student's Book Four (用户上传教材): Language in use
points.structureEn: 连 (lián, even) + Surprising Person/Thing + 都/也 (dōu/yě) + Verb/Description
points.noteEn: 连 highlights a surprising person or thing, and 都 or 也 must follow it. It is not the ordinary 都 that sums up a list.

points.name: 不得了（极高程度）
points.explainEn: Use 得不得了 after an adjective or state verb to mean 'extremely'.
points.structure: 主语 + 形容词/状态动词 + 得 + 不得了

examples.en: It is extremely hot today.
examples.py: Jīntiān rè de bùdéliǎo.

examples.en: She is extremely busy.
examples.py: Tā máng de bùdéliǎo.

examples.en: I am terribly hungry.
examples.py: Wǒ è de bùdéliǎo.

exercises.q: 听说考试通过了，他高兴得___。
exercises.body: 听说考试通过了，他高兴得___。
exercises.explain: “形容词＋得＋不得了”表示程度极高；“了不起”是夸人厉害，不能放在“得”后面作程度补语。
exercises.explainEn: Adj + 得 + 不得了 means 'extremely'; 了不起 means 'amazing (person)' and is not a degree complement.

exercises.q: 这家店的菜贵得不得了，___。
exercises.body: 这家店的菜贵得不得了，___。
options: 跟附近的店比还算正常
exercises.explain: “贵得不得了”是非常非常贵，后面要说贵得很厉害的情况，不能说“贵一点儿、稍微贵”。
exercises.explainEn: 贵得不得了 means extremely expensive, so what follows must be very expensive, not just a little more.

exercises.q: 下面哪一句有错？
exercises.body: 下面哪一句有错？
options: 这里的风景不得了漂亮。
这个消息让大家高兴得不得了。
这个孩子聪明得不得了。
今天的作业多得不得了。
exercises.explain: “不得了”要放在“形容词＋得”后面：这里的风景漂亮得不得了。
exercises.explainEn: 不得了 comes after adj + 得: 这里的风景漂亮得不得了.

exercises.q: I am extremely tired.
exercises.body: I am extremely tired.

exercises.q: It is terribly cold today.
exercises.body: It is terribly cold today.

exercises.q: He is extremely happy.
exercises.body: He is extremely happy.

points.note: 注意为“形容词/状态动词+得不得了”，而不是单独“不得了”作普通状语。
points.source: Discover China Student's Book Four (用户上传教材): Language in use
points.structureEn: Subject + Adjective / Feeling Verb + 得 (de) + 不得了 (bùdéliǎo, extremely)
points.noteEn: The pattern is adjective / feeling verb + 得不得了. 不得了 is not used on its own here as an ordinary adverb.

points.name: 再和又（重复动作）
points.explainEn: Use 又 for a repeated past action, and 再 for doing something again later.
points.structure: 已发生：又 + 动词；将来/要求：再 + 动词

examples.en: He was late again yesterday.
examples.py: Tā zuótiān yòu chídào le.

examples.en: Please say it again.
examples.py: Qǐng zài shuō yí biàn.

examples.en: We will come again tomorrow.
examples.py: Míngtiān wǒmen zài lái.

exercises.q: 他上周迟到了两次，今天___迟到了。
exercises.body: 他上周迟到了两次，今天___迟到了。
exercises.explain: 已经发生的重复用“又”；“再”用于还没发生的重复，“重新”是从头再做一次。
exercises.explainEn: For a repeat that has already happened use 又; 再 is for repeats that haven't happened yet, and 重新 means redo from the start.

exercises.q: 你刚才说得太快了，请你再___。
exercises.body: 你刚才说得太快了，请你再___。
exercises.explain: “再”表示将来的重复，请求别人时后面不能带“了、过”。
exercises.explainEn: 再 is for a future repeat; in a request it cannot take 了 or 过.

exercises.q: 下面哪一句有错？
exercises.body: 下面哪一句有错？
options: 我昨天再去了一次那家书店。
这个问题我们明天再讨论吧。
这个菜很好吃，我明天还想再来吃。
她上个月病了一次，这个月又病了。
exercises.explain: 昨天已经发生的重复要用“又”：我昨天又去了一次那家书店。
exercises.explainEn: A repeat that already happened yesterday needs 又: 我昨天又去了一次那家书店。

exercises.q: He called me again yesterday.
exercises.a: 他昨天又给我打电话了。
exercises.body: He called me again yesterday.

exercises.q: Please try again.
exercises.body: Please try again.

exercises.q: Let's meet again next week.
exercises.body: Let's meet again next week.

points.note: 避免把“又”和“再”机械地等同于英文again；根据动作是否已发生选择。
points.source: Discover China Student's Book Four (用户上传教材): Language in use
points.structureEn: Past / already happened: 又 (yòu, again) + Verb; Future / request: 再 (zài, again) + Verb
points.noteEn: Don't treat 又 and 再 as simply meaning "again". Choose by whether the action has already happened (又) or has not happened yet (再).

points.name: 一下和一点儿（轻微语气）
points.explainEn: Use 一下 to make an action short or polite. Use 一点儿 to mean a small amount.
points.structure: 动词 + 一下；动词 + 一点儿 + 名词；（动词 +）形容词 + 一点儿

examples.en: Please wait a moment.
examples.py: Qǐng nǐ děng yíxià.

examples.en: I would like a little water.
examples.py: Wǒ xiǎng hē yìdiǎnr shuǐ.

examples.en: Could you speak a little more slowly?
examples.py: Nǐ kěyǐ shuō màn yìdiǎnr ma?

exercises.q: 这件衣服有点儿大，有没有小___的？
exercises.body: 这件衣服有点儿大，有没有小___的？
exercises.explain: 形容词后面表示比较、稍微用“一点儿”；“一下”放在动词后，“有点儿”放在形容词前。
exercises.explainEn: After an adjective, 'a bit more' is 一点儿; 一下 follows verbs and 有点儿 goes before adjectives.

exercises.q: 天太冷了，我想喝一点儿___。
exercises.body: 天太冷了，我想喝一点儿___。
exercises.explain: “一点儿”后面直接加名词，不能再加“一碗、几碗、很多”这样的数量。
exercises.explainEn: 一点儿 is followed directly by the noun, with no extra amount like 一碗 or 很多.

exercises.q: 下面哪一句有错？
exercises.body: 下面哪一句有错？
options: 我想去超市买一点儿水果。
今天一点儿冷，你多穿件衣服。
exercises.explain: 形容词前面表示“有些不如意”要用“有点儿”：今天有点儿冷。
exercises.explainEn: Before an adjective, 'a bit (too)' is 有点儿: 今天有点儿冷.

exercises.q: Please look at this.
exercises.body: Please look at this.

exercises.q: I would like a little tea.
exercises.body: I would like a little tea.

exercises.q: Please speak a little louder.
exercises.body: Please speak a little louder.

points.note: 一下修饰动作；一点儿表达数量或程度。
points.source: Discover China Student's Book Four (用户上传教材): Language in use
points.structureEn: Verb + 一下 (yíxià, briefly); Verb + 一点儿 (yìdiǎnr, a little) + Noun; (Verb +) Adjective + 一点儿
points.noteEn: 一下 goes with an action; 一点儿 shows an amount or a degree.

points.name: 起来（动作/新状态开始）
points.explainEn: Use 起来 after a verb or adjective to show something starts.
points.structure: 动词/形容词 + 起来（常带“了”）；带宾语：动词 + 起 + 宾语 + 来

examples.en: The child started crying.
examples.py: Háizi kū qǐlai le.

examples.en: The weather is getting warmer.
examples.py: Tiānqì mànmàn rè qǐlai le.

examples.en: Everyone started laughing.
examples.py: Dàjiā dōu xiào qǐlai le.

exercises.q: 听了他的笑话，大家都笑___了。
exercises.body: 听了他的笑话，大家都笑___了。
exercises.explain: “起来”表示动作开始，“笑起来”就是开始笑；“下来、下去、上来”没有这个意思。
exercises.explainEn: 起来 marks the start of an action, so 笑起来 = start laughing; 下来, 下去 and 上来 do not mean that.

exercises.q: 说着说着，她___起来。
exercises.body: 说着说着，她___起来。
exercises.explain: 表示开始的“起来”前面用动词或“动词＋了”，不能用“过、着、在”。
exercises.explainEn: 起来 (start) follows a bare verb or verb + 了, not 过, 着 or 在.

exercises.q: 下面哪一句有错？
exercises.body: 下面哪一句有错？
options: 他一回家就玩游戏起来。
孩子们高兴地唱起歌来。
最近他的身体好起来了。
他们一见面就聊起天来。
exercises.explain: 带宾语时宾语放在“起”和“来”中间：他一回家就玩起游戏来。
exercises.explainEn: With an object, it goes between 起 and 来: 他一回家就玩起游戏来.

exercises.q: It started raining.
exercises.body: It started raining.

exercises.q: He began to sing.
exercises.body: He began to sing.

exercises.q: Everyone started chatting.
exercises.body: Everyone started chatting.

points.note: 这里讲开始义，不与“想起来、看起来”等引申义混淆。
points.source: Discover China Student's Book Four (用户上传教材): Language in use
points.structureEn: Verb / Adjective + 起来 (qǐlái, start to) (+ 了 le); with an object: Verb + 起 (qǐ) + Object + 来 (lái)
points.noteEn: Here 起来 means "to start". Don't mix it up with other uses such as 想起来 (to remember) or 看起来 (to seem).

lessons.title: 让您的旅行没有后顾之忧！

points.name: 至于（引出新话题）
points.explainEn: Use 至于 to move to a related point: 'as for…'.
points.structure: 前面的情况。至于 + 新话题，+ 补充说明

examples.zh: 去不去我还没决定，至于时间，我们以后再说。
examples.en: I have not decided whether to go. As for the time, we can talk later.
examples.py: Qù bu qù wǒ hái méi juédìng, zhìyú shíjiān, wǒmen yǐhòu zài shuō.

examples.zh: 我喜欢这里的食物，至于天气，我还不习惯。
examples.en: I like the food here; as for the weather, I am not used to it.
examples.py: Wǒ xǐhuan zhèlǐ de shíwù, zhìyú tiānqì, wǒ hái bù xíguàn.

examples.zh: 车票买好了，至于酒店，还没订。
examples.en: The tickets are bought; as for the hotel, it is not booked yet.
examples.py: Chēpiào mǎi hǎo le, zhìyú jiǔdiàn, hái méi dìng.

exercises.q: 我们下周去上海，___住哪儿，到了再说。
exercises.body: 我们下周去上海，___住哪儿，到了再说。
exercises.explain: 说完一件事再引出新话题用“至于”；“由于”表示原因，“甚至”表示更进一步。
exercises.explainEn: 至于 brings up a new topic; 由于 gives a reason and 甚至 means "even".

exercises.q: 这份工作工资不错，离家也近，至于___，我还要再问问。
exercises.body: 这份工作工资不错，离家也近，至于___，我还要再问问。
exercises.explain: “至于”要引出一个新话题；工资和远近前面已经说了，只有休息时间是新话题。
exercises.explainEn: 至于 introduces a new topic; pay and distance were already mentioned, only the days off are new.

exercises.q: 下面哪一句有错？
exercises.body: 下面哪一句有错？
options: 他会来，至于什么时候来，我不清楚。
他每天工作到很晚，至于身体越来越不好。
机票已经买好了，至于住的地方，还没找。
我喜欢这个城市，至于这里的冬天，我还不太习惯。
exercises.explain: 这里要表示结果，应该用“以至于”或“所以”：他每天工作到很晚，以至于身体越来越不好。
exercises.explainEn: A result is meant here, so use 以至于 or 所以 instead of 至于.

exercises.q: The hotel is fine; as for the price, I will ask tomorrow.
exercises.a: 酒店不错，至于价格，我明天再问。
exercises.body: The hotel is fine; as for the price, I will ask tomorrow.

exercises.q: The luggage is packed; as for the hotel, we have already booked it.
exercises.a: 行李收拾好了，至于酒店，我们已经订好了。
exercises.body: The luggage is packed; as for the hotel, we have already booked it.

exercises.q: That's all for today; as for this question, we can discuss it later.
exercises.a: 今天就到这儿，至于这个问题，我们可以以后再讨论。
exercises.body: That's all for today; as for this question, we can discuss it later.

points.note: 是篇章层面的转话题结构；新话题应与前文相关。
points.source: Discover China Student's Book Four (用户上传教材): Language in use
points.structureEn: Previous Point. 至于 (zhìyú, as for) + New Topic, + Comment
points.noteEn: 至于 switches topics across sentences; the new topic should be related to what was said before.

points.name: 不如（比较）
points.explainEn: Use A 不如 B to say A is not as good as B in some way.
points.structure: A + 不如 + B +（形容词/动词短语）

examples.zh: 坐公交车不如坐地铁快。
examples.en: Taking the bus is not as fast as taking the subway.
examples.py: Zuò gōngjiāochē bùrú zuò dìtiě kuài.

examples.en: My Chinese is not as good as hers.
examples.py: Wǒ de Zhōngwén bùrú tā hǎo.

examples.zh: 今天的天气不如昨天好。
examples.en: Today's weather is not as good as yesterday's.
examples.py: Jīntiān de tiānqì bùrú zuótiān hǎo.

exercises.q: 在家看电影太没意思了，___去电影院看。
exercises.body: 在家看电影太没意思了，___去电影院看。
exercises.explain: “不如”可以单独用，表示“还是……更好”；“比、跟”后面必须有比较的结果。
exercises.explainEn: 不如 can stand alone meaning 'it would be better to'; 比 and 跟 need a result after them.

exercises.q: 这家饭馆的菜不如那家___。
exercises.body: 这家饭馆的菜不如那家___。
exercises.explain: “A不如B”后面一般用正面的形容词，意思是A没有B好吃；不能用“难吃、差”。
exercises.explainEn: A 不如 B takes a positive adjective (A is not as tasty as B), not 难吃 or 差.

exercises.q: 下面哪一句有错？
exercises.body: 下面哪一句有错？
options: 一个人去不如大家一起去。
我的房间不如他的房间脏。
这儿的天气不如南方暖和。
exercises.explain: “不如”后面不用负面形容词，可以说：我的房间没有他的房间脏。
exercises.explainEn: 不如 is not used with negative adjectives; say 我的房间没有他的房间脏.

exercises.q: This room is not as big as that one.
exercises.body: This room is not as big as that one.

exercises.q: Walking is not as fast as cycling.
exercises.body: Walking is not as fast as cycling.

exercises.q: I am not as tall as you.
exercises.body: I am not as tall as you.

points.note: “不如”表示比较不及，不是单纯建议意义的“不如我们……”。
points.source: Discover China Student's Book Four (用户上传教材): Language in use
points.structureEn: A + 不如 (bùrú, not as…as) + B + (Adjective / Verb Phrase)
points.noteEn: Here 不如 compares two things ("not as … as"). It is not the 不如 used for suggestions, as in 不如我们…… ("we might as well…").

points.name: ……分之……（分数/百分比）
points.explainEn: Say the denominator first, then 分之, then the numerator.
points.structure: 分母 + 分之 + 分子；百分之 + 数字

examples.zh: 我们班三分之一的学生住在学校。
examples.en: One third of our class lives at school.
examples.py: Wǒmen bān sān fēn zhī yī de xuésheng zhù zài xuéxiào.

examples.zh: 百分之五十的人喜欢这个办法。
examples.en: Fifty percent of people like this method.
examples.py: Bǎi fēn zhī wǔshí de rén xǐhuan zhège bànfǎ.

examples.zh: 我完成了四分之三的作业。
examples.en: I finished three quarters of the homework.
examples.py: Wǒ wánchéng le sì fēn zhī sān de zuòyè.

exercises.q: 我们班二十个学生，男生五个，是全班的___。
exercises.body: 我们班二十个学生，男生五个，是全班的___。
exercises.explain: 分数先说分母再说分子，二十个里有五个就是“四分之一”；“一分之四”顺序反了。
exercises.explainEn: Say the denominator first: 5 out of 20 is 四分之一; 一分之四 has the order reversed.

exercises.q: 全班三分之一是女生，就是说___。
exercises.body: 全班三分之一是女生，就是说___。
exercises.explain: “三分之一”是分成三份占一份，就是三个人里有一个女生。
exercises.explainEn: 三分之一 is one of three parts, so one in every three students is a girl.

exercises.q: 下面哪一句有错？
exercises.body: 下面哪一句有错？
options: 我们班百分五十的学生是女生。
我们只完成了五分之一的工作。
他把工资的百分之二十存了起来。
三分之二的人同意这个办法。
exercises.explain: 百分数中间不能少“之”：百分之五十的学生是女生。
exercises.explainEn: A percentage needs 之: 百分之五十.

exercises.q: One half of the students are here.
exercises.a: 二分之一的学生在这儿。
exercises.body: One half of the students are here.

exercises.q: Twenty percent of the people agreed.
exercises.a: 百分之二十的人同意了。
exercises.body: Twenty percent of the people agreed.

exercises.q: I have finished two thirds of the work.
exercises.a: 我完成了三分之二的工作。
exercises.body: I have finished two thirds of the work.

points.note: 中文顺序与英语分数表达不同；百分数读“百分之+数”。
points.source: Discover China Student's Book Four (用户上传教材): Language in use
points.structureEn: Denominator + 分之 (fēn zhī, over) + Numerator; 百分之 (bǎi fēn zhī, percent) + Number
points.noteEn: Chinese puts the parts of a fraction in a different order from English. Percentages are read as 百分之 + number.

points.name: 还 + 正面形容词（语气缓和）
points.explainEn: Use 还 before a positive adjective to mean 'quite / reasonably', not very strong praise.
points.structure: 主语 + 还 + 好/不错/方便/可以等

examples.en: This restaurant is quite good.
examples.py: Zhè jiā fànguǎn hái búcuò.

examples.en: This method is okay.
examples.py: Zhège bànfǎ hái kěyǐ.

examples.en: Transport here is reasonably convenient.
examples.py: Zhèlǐ de jiāotōng hái fāngbiàn.

exercises.q: 这家饭馆的菜___可以，不过不算特别好吃。
exercises.body: 这家饭馆的菜___可以，不过不算特别好吃。
exercises.explain: “还＋可以”表示马马虎虎、过得去，正好跟后面的“不算特别好吃”配合。
exercises.explainEn: 还 + 可以 means 'passable', which matches 'not especially tasty'.

exercises.q: 你的汉字写得还可以，___。
exercises.body: 你的汉字写得还可以，___。
exercises.explain: “还可以”是不错但不是很好，后面常说一点不足，不能接很高的评价。
exercises.explainEn: 还可以 means OK but not great, so a small weakness follows, not high praise.

exercises.q: 下面哪一句有错？
exercises.body: 下面哪一句有错？
options: 这个电影还好极了，我看了三遍。
exercises.explain: “还”表示一般、过得去，不能跟“极了”一起用：这个电影好极了。
exercises.explainEn: 还 means 'fairly OK' and cannot go with 极了; say 这个电影好极了.

exercises.q: This hotel is quite good.
exercises.body: This hotel is quite good.

exercises.q: His Chinese is OK.
exercises.body: His Chinese is OK.

exercises.q: The price is not bad.
exercises.body: The price is not bad.

points.note: 教材强调“还”缓和正面评价，非表示“still”的时间副词。
points.source: Discover China Student's Book Four (用户上传教材): Language in use
points.structureEn: Subject + 还 (hái, quite / reasonably) + Positive Adjective
points.noteEn: The textbook stresses that this 还 softens a positive comment. It is not the time word 还 meaning "still".

points.name: 动宾离合词
points.explainEn: Some verb-object words can split. Put time, number, or 了 between the two parts.
points.structure: 动词 + 了/数量/时长 + 宾语；如 睡了一个好觉

examples.en: I slept well last night.
examples.py: Wǒ zuówǎn shuì le yí ge hǎo jiào.

examples.en: We have met twice.
examples.py: Wǒmen jiàn guo liǎng cì miàn.

examples.en: He sang a song.
examples.py: Tā chàng le yì shǒu gē.

exercises.q: 我们是去年认识的，到现在只___。
exercises.body: 我们是去年认识的，到现在只___。
exercises.explain: “见面”是离合词，“过”和次数要插在“见”和“面”中间。
exercises.explainEn: 见面 is a separable verb: 过 and the count go between 见 and 面.

exercises.q: 昨天晚上我睡了___觉，今天一点儿也不累。
exercises.body: 昨天晚上我睡了___觉，今天一点儿也不累。
exercises.explain: 离合词中间可以加“一个好”这样的数量修饰，“很好、很多”不能插在中间。
exercises.explainEn: A separable verb can take 一个好 in the middle; 很好 and 很多 cannot go there.

exercises.q: 下面哪一句有错？
exercises.body: 下面哪一句有错？
options: 他昨天游了一个小时泳。
我昨天见面了我的老朋友。
exercises.explain: “见面”后面不能再带宾语，应说：我昨天跟我的老朋友见面了。
exercises.explainEn: 见面 cannot take an object; say 我昨天跟我的老朋友见面了.

exercises.q: I slept for eight hours.
exercises.body: I slept for eight hours.

exercises.q: We met once yesterday.
exercises.body: We met once yesterday.

exercises.q: She danced for an hour.
exercises.body: She danced for an hour.

points.note: 注意如“见面、睡觉、跳舞”中间可插入成分，不是每个动宾短语都以同样方式离合。
points.source: Discover China Student's Book Four (用户上传教材): Language in use
points.structureEn: Verb Part + 了 (le) / Amount / Time + Object Part; e.g. 睡 + 了一个好 + 觉
points.noteEn: Words like 见面, 睡觉 and 跳舞 can take other words in the middle, but not every verb-object phrase splits in the same way.

points.name: 通过（方法/途径）
points.explainEn: Use 通过 to show the way or method used to achieve something: 'through / by'.
points.structure: 主语 + 通过 + 方法/途径 + 动词 + 结果

examples.en: I met him through a friend.
examples.py: Wǒ tōngguò péngyou rènshi le tā.

examples.en: We keep in touch by email.
examples.py: Wǒmen tōngguò yóujiàn liánxì.

examples.zh: 她通过练习提高了中文水平。
examples.en: She improved her Chinese through practice.
examples.py: Tā tōngguò liànxí tígāo le Zhōngwén shuǐpíng.

exercises.q: 我是___网上的广告找到这份工作的。
exercises.body: 我是___网上的广告找到这份工作的。
exercises.explain: “通过”引出做事的方法或途径；“经过”多指时间、过程或路过某地。
exercises.explainEn: 通过 introduces a means or channel; 经过 is about a process, time, or passing a place.

exercises.q: 通过这次实习，___。
exercises.body: 通过这次实习，___。
options: 我每天都要坐地铁上班
我实习的公司在市中心
我对这份工作了解多了
exercises.explain: “通过……”说的是经过某种方法或经历得到的结果，实习以后对工作更了解了；上下班的方式、公司在哪儿都不是实习带来的结果，下个月才开始也跟“这次实习”矛盾。
exercises.explainEn: 通过… states a result gained through a means or experience: after the internship I know the job better; how I commute or where the company is are not results of it.

exercises.q: 下面哪一句有错？
exercises.body: 下面哪一句有错？
options: 我们可以通过电话联系。
他通过朋友找到了房子。
通过这次旅行，我更了解中国了。
我每天上班都通过那家书店。
exercises.explain: 路过某个地方要用“经过”：我每天上班都经过那家书店。
exercises.explainEn: For passing by a place use 经过: 我每天上班都经过那家书店。

exercises.q: I found the job through a friend.
exercises.a: 我通过朋友找到了工作。
exercises.body: I found the job through a friend.

exercises.q: We learned the news online.
exercises.a: 我们通过网络知道了这个消息。
exercises.body: We learned the news online.

exercises.q: He improved his English by listening.
exercises.a: 他通过听力练习提高了英语水平。
exercises.body: He improved his English by listening.

points.note: 说明达成结果的方式；不是空间移动意义的“通过大门”。
points.source: Discover China Student's Book Four (用户上传教材): Language in use
points.structureEn: Subject + 通过 (tōngguò, through/by) + Method + Verb + Result
points.noteEn: It shows the way a result is reached. It is not 通过 in the physical sense of "passing through", as in 通过大门.

points.name: 由（动作执行者）
points.explainEn: Use 由 to name who is responsible for doing an action. It is formal.
points.structure: 事情/动作 + 由 + 人/机构 + 动词

examples.en: The school organizes the event.
examples.py: Huódòng yóu xuéxiào zǔzhī.

examples.en: I am responsible for this matter.
examples.py: Zhè jiàn shì yóu wǒ fùzé.

examples.en: The meeting is hosted by Teacher Wang.
examples.py: Huìyì yóu Wáng lǎoshī zhǔchí.

exercises.q: 这次会议___李经理主持。
exercises.body: 这次会议___李经理主持。
exercises.explain: “由”引出负责做这件事的人；“被”多用于不如意的事，这里不合适。
exercises.explainEn: 由 introduces who is responsible for doing it; 被 is mostly for unwanted events and does not fit here.

exercises.q: 这次晚会的节目由学生们___。
exercises.body: 这次晚会的节目由学生们___。
exercises.explain: “由”后面的人要负责去做一件事，所以要跟“准备”这样的动作。
exercises.explainEn: With 由, the person carries out a task, so an action like 准备 must follow.

exercises.q: 下面哪一句有错？
exercises.body: 下面哪一句有错？
options: 学生的作业由老师检查。
这次比赛由王老师来安排。
孩子们的午饭由学校提供。
exercises.explain: 蛋糕被吃掉是不如意的事，不是谁“负责”做的事，要用“被”：我的蛋糕被弟弟吃了。
exercises.explainEn: Having your cake eaten is not a task someone is in charge of; use 被: 我的蛋糕被弟弟吃了.

exercises.q: The hotel is booked by the company.
exercises.body: The hotel is booked by the company.

exercises.q: This job is handled by him.
exercises.body: This job is handled by him.

exercises.q: The trip is arranged by the teacher.
exercises.body: The trip is arranged by the teacher.

points.note: 较正式，强调执行者或责任人；不可与“被”的所有被动用法机械等同。
points.source: Discover China Student's Book Four (用户上传教材): Language in use
points.structureEn: Event / Task + 由 (yóu, by) + Person / Organization + Verb
points.noteEn: 由 is fairly formal and stresses who does the action or is responsible for it. Don't treat it as the same as every passive use of 被.

points.name: 书面语中的单音节形式
points.pinyin: shūmiànyǔ zhōng de dān yīnjié xíngshì
points.explainEn: In formal writing, some two-character words can appear as shorter one-character forms.
points.structure: 口语双音节词 → 书面单音节词；例如 如果→如，或者→或

examples.en: If you have questions, please contact us.
examples.py: Rú yǒu wèntí, qǐng liánxì wǒmen.

examples.en: Please reply before Friday.
examples.py: Qǐng yú zhōuwǔ qián huífù.

examples.zh: 请通过邮件或电话联系。
examples.en: Please contact us by email or phone.
examples.py: Qǐng tōngguò yóujiàn huò diànhuà liánxì.

exercises.q: 请___周一前交作业。
exercises.body: 请___周一前交作业。
exercises.explain: 书面语里“于”相当于“在”，“于周一前”就是“在周一前”。
exercises.explainEn: In written Chinese 于 means 在, so 于周一前 = before Monday.

exercises.q: 如需帮助，___。
exercises.body: 如需帮助，___。
options: 例如学习和工作上的问题
exercises.explain: 书面语“如”就是“如果”，后面要说在这个条件下怎么做；它不是“比如、像”的意思。
exercises.explainEn: In formal writing 如 means "if", so the next part says what to do; it does not mean "for example".

exercises.q: 下面哪一句有错？
exercises.body: 下面哪一句有错？
options: 请于下午五点前离开教室。
请通过电话或邮件报名。
如有问题，请与我们联系。
exercises.explain: “于”就是“在”的意思，“于在”重复了，应说“这家公司成立于2005年”。
exercises.explainEn: 于 already means 在, so 于在 is doubled; say 这家公司成立于2005年.

exercises.q: If you need help, please call.
exercises.body: If you need help, please call.

exercises.q: Please reply by email or phone.
exercises.body: Please reply by email or phone.

exercises.q: If there are any changes, please tell me.
exercises.body: If there are any changes, please tell me.

points.note: 本项是教材语体知识，不是一个单一生产性句型；练习选择教材例示的常见书面单音节词。
points.source: Discover China Student's Book Four (用户上传教材): Language in use
points.structureEn: Everyday Two-character Word → Formal One-character Word (e.g., 如果 → 如, 或者 → 或)
points.noteEn: This point is about formal written style, not one fixed sentence pattern. The practice uses common one-character formal words shown in the textbook.

points.name: 倒（转折/让步）
points.explainEn: Use 倒 to show a contrasting or unexpected positive or negative point.
points.structure: 先说情况A，主语 + 倒 + 相反/补充判断

examples.zh: 这家店很小，东西倒不错。
examples.en: This shop is small, but the products are actually good.
examples.py: Zhè jiā diàn hěn xiǎo, dōngxi dào búcuò.

examples.zh: 他中文说得不多，发音倒很好。
examples.en: He does not speak much Chinese, but his pronunciation is good.
examples.py: Tā Zhōngwén shuō de bù duō, fāyīn dào hěn hǎo.

examples.zh: 这个地方不大，人倒挺多。
examples.en: This place isn't big, but there are actually quite a lot of people.
examples.py: Zhège dìfang bú dà, rén dào tǐng duō.

exercises.q: 这个房子不大，房间___挺多的。
exercises.body: 这个房子不大，房间___挺多的。
exercises.explain: “倒”表示跟前面的情况相反，房子不大却房间多。
exercises.explainEn: 倒 marks a contrast with what came before: the flat is small, yet it has many rooms.

exercises.q: 这家饭馆环境一般，菜倒___。
exercises.body: 这家饭馆环境一般，菜倒___。
exercises.explain: “倒”表示跟前面相反：环境一般，菜却挺好吃。
exercises.explainEn: 倒 marks a contrast with what came before: the setting is ordinary, but the food is actually good.

exercises.q: 下面哪一句有错？
exercises.body: 下面哪一句有错？
options: 他学中文时间不长，说得倒挺流利。
这里冬天很冷，夏天倒挺舒服。
他个子不高，篮球倒打得很好。
这个手机很便宜，倒质量很好。
exercises.explain: “倒”是副词，要放在主语后面：这个手机很便宜，质量倒很好。
exercises.explainEn: 倒 is an adverb and goes after the subject: 质量倒很好.

exercises.q: The room is small, but it is quite clean.
exercises.body: The room is small, but it is quite clean.

exercises.q: He is young, but he has a lot of experience.
exercises.a: 他很年轻，经验倒很丰富。
exercises.body: He is young, but he has a lot of experience.

exercises.q: It's cheap, but the quality is actually good.
exercises.a: 价格很便宜，质量倒不错。
exercises.body: It's cheap, but the quality is actually good.

points.note: “倒”表达与预期不同或让步，常隐含对比。
points.source: Discover China Student's Book Four (用户上传教材): Language in use
points.structureEn: Situation A, Subject + 倒 (dào, actually / though) + Contrasting Comment
points.noteEn: 倒 shows something different from what you would expect, or a concession; it usually implies a contrast.

points.name: 好好 + 动词（认真/充分地做）
points.explainEn: Use 好好 before a verb to mean 'do it properly / carefully / well'.
points.structure: 主语 + 好好 + 动词（+ 结果）

examples.en: Please get some proper rest first.
examples.py: Nǐ xiān hǎohǎo xiūxi.

examples.en: I want to study Chinese seriously.
examples.py: Wǒ xiǎng hǎohǎo xuéxí Zhōngwén.

examples.en: Let's discuss this carefully.
examples.py: Wǒmen hǎohǎo tǎolùn yíxià ba.

exercises.q: 考试快到了，你得___复习一下。
exercises.body: 考试快到了，你得___复习一下。
exercises.explain: “好好＋动词”表示认真地做；“很好、挺好、好极了”是评价，不能直接放在动词前面。
exercises.explainEn: 好好 + verb means "do it properly"; 很好/挺好/好极了 are judgments and can't go right before a verb.

exercises.q: 你这几天太累了，周末好好___吧。
exercises.body: 你这几天太累了，周末好好___吧。
exercises.explain: “好好”用来建议、要求，后面常跟动词或动词重叠，不能带“过、了、着”。
exercises.explainEn: 好好 in a suggestion takes a verb or doubled verb, not 过, 了 or 着.

exercises.q: 下面哪一句有错？
exercises.body: 下面哪一句有错？
options: 这次旅行我想好好玩一玩。
我们好好想一想再决定。
exercises.explain: “好好”放在动词前，不能作“得”后的补语：他汉语说得很好。
exercises.explainEn: 好好 goes before verbs, not after 得; say 他汉语说得很好.

exercises.q: Please think carefully.
exercises.body: Please think carefully.

exercises.q: You need to prepare well.
exercises.body: You need to prepare well.

exercises.q: We should make good use of the time.
exercises.body: We should make good use of the time.

points.note: 教材还允许与“想/应该/得”等能愿词连用，表示认真做、做得更好。
points.source: Discover China Student's Book Four (用户上传教材): Language in use
points.structureEn: Subject + 好好 (hǎohǎo, properly / carefully) + Verb
points.noteEn: The textbook also allows it after words like 想, 应该 and 得 (děi, "must"), meaning to do something seriously or do it better.

points.name: 既然……，就/那……
points.explainEn: Use 既然…就… when the reason is already known: 'since…, then…'.
points.structure: 既然 + 已知事实，就/那 + 结论/建议

examples.zh: 既然你累了，就休息一下吧。
examples.en: Since you are tired, take a rest.
examples.py: Jìrán nǐ lèi le, jiù xiūxi yíxià ba.

examples.zh: 既然已经到了，我们就进去吧。
examples.en: Since we have arrived, let's go in.
examples.py: Jìrán yǐjīng dào le, wǒmen jiù jìnqu ba.

examples.zh: 既然你不喜欢，那就别买。
examples.en: Since you do not like it, don't buy it.
examples.py: Jìrán nǐ bù xǐhuan, nà jiù bié mǎi.

exercises.q: ___你已经决定了，我就不说什么了。
exercises.body: ___你已经决定了，我就不说什么了。
exercises.explain: “既然”引出已知的事实，后面用“就”得出结论；“虽然、尽管、即使”不跟“就”这样配合。
exercises.explainEn: 既然 gives a known fact and 就 draws the conclusion; 虽然, 尽管 and 即使 do not pair with 就 here.

exercises.q: 既然这件衣服你穿着不合适，___。
exercises.body: 既然这件衣服你穿着不合适，___。
exercises.explain: “既然”说出已知事实，后面用“就”得出结论；“但是、可是、虽然”表示转折，不能跟“既然”配合。
exercises.explainEn: 既然 states a known fact and leads to a conclusion with 就; 但是/可是/虽然 show contrast and don't pair with it.

exercises.q: 下面哪一句有错？
exercises.body: 下面哪一句有错？
options: 既然大家都同意，那就这么办吧。
既然你很忙，但是你还是来了。
既然来了，就多住几天吧。
既然你不舒服，就早点儿回家吧。
exercises.explain: 表示转折应该用“虽然……但是……”：虽然你很忙，但是你还是来了。
exercises.explainEn: For a contrast use 虽然……但是……, not 既然.

exercises.q: Since it is raining, let's stay home.
exercises.a: 既然下雨了，我们就待在家里吧。
exercises.body: Since it is raining, let's stay home.

exercises.q: Since you have time, please help me.
exercises.a: 既然你有时间，就帮帮我吧。
exercises.body: Since you have time, please help me.

exercises.q: Since everyone agrees, let's start.
exercises.a: 既然大家都同意，我们就开始吧。
exercises.body: Since everyone agrees, let's start.

points.note: 既然引出双方已知或认可的事实，不等同假设的“如果”。
points.source: Discover China Student's Book Four (用户上传教材): Language in use
points.structureEn: 既然 (jìrán, since) + Known Fact, 就 (jiù, then) / 那 (nà, then) + Result
points.noteEn: 既然 introduces a fact that both people already know or accept. It is not the same as 如果 ("if"), which is only a guess.

points.name: 再……不过了（程度极高）
points.explainEn: Use 再 + adjective + 不过了 to mean 'couldn't be more…'.
points.structure: 再 + 形容词/心理动词 + 不过了

examples.en: This method could not be better.
examples.py: Zhège bànfǎ zài hǎo búguò le.

examples.zh: 这个时间再合适不过了。
examples.en: This time could not be more suitable.
examples.py: Zhège shíjiān zài héshì búguò le.

examples.zh: 能见到你，我再高兴不过了。
examples.en: I could not be happier to see you.
examples.py: Néng jiàndào nǐ, wǒ zài gāoxìng búguò le.

exercises.q: 你能来帮忙，那___好不过了。
exercises.body: 你能来帮忙，那___好不过了。
exercises.explain: 固定格式是“再＋形容词＋不过了”，表示没有比这更……的了。
exercises.explainEn: The fixed pattern is 再 + adj + 不过了, meaning nothing could be more so.

exercises.q: 这家店离地铁站只有一分钟，交通再___不过了。
exercises.body: 这家店离地铁站只有一分钟，交通再___不过了。
exercises.explain: “再……不过了”中间放一个光杆形容词，不能加“很、了”，意思也要跟前面一致。
exercises.explainEn: 再……不过了 takes a bare adjective, without 很 or 了, matching the context.

exercises.q: 下面哪一句有错？
exercises.body: 下面哪一句有错？
options: 这件事交给他办再合适不过了。
能和大家一起工作，我再高兴不过了。
这个问题再简单不过了。
exercises.explain: “了”要放在最后：这个菜再好吃不过了。
exercises.explainEn: 了 must come last: 这个菜再好吃不过了.

exercises.q: This is the best time possible.
exercises.body: This is the best time possible.

exercises.q: Your idea couldn't be better.
exercises.body: Your idea couldn't be better.

exercises.q: I couldn't be more satisfied.
exercises.body: I couldn't be more satisfied.

points.note: 惯用结构，整体表示极端程度，不应按字面误解为“再做一次”。
points.source: Discover China Student's Book Four (用户上传教材): Language in use
points.structureEn: 再 (zài) + Adjective / Feeling Verb + 不过了 (bú guò le, could not be more…)
points.noteEn: This is a fixed expression: as a whole it means "as … as can be". Don't read 再 literally as "do it again".

points.name: ……死了（极高程度）
points.explainEn: Use adjective + 死了 to mean 'extremely'. It is very colloquial.
points.structure: 形容词/心理动词 + 死了

examples.en: I am exhausted.
examples.py: Wǒ lèi sǐ le.

examples.en: It is unbearably hot today.
examples.py: Jīntiān rè sǐ le.

examples.zh: 听到这个消息，我高兴死了。
examples.en: I was extremely happy to hear this.
examples.py: Tīngdào zhège xiāoxi, wǒ gāoxìng sǐ le.

exercises.q: 一天没吃东西，我饿___。
exercises.body: 一天没吃东西，我饿___。
exercises.explain: 表示程度极高直接说“形容词＋死了”，中间不加“得”。
exercises.explainEn: Extreme degree is adj + 死了 directly, with no 得.

exercises.q: 听说他考上了北京大学，他妈妈___死了。
exercises.body: 听说他考上了北京大学，他妈妈___死了。
exercises.explain: “死了”已经表示程度极高，前面不能再加“很、非常”，也不加“得”。
exercises.explainEn: 死了 already means 'extremely', so no 很, 非常 or 得 before it.

exercises.q: 下面哪一句有错？
exercises.body: 下面哪一句有错？
options: 这个电影非常好看死了。
exercises.explain: “死了”前面不能再用“非常”：这个电影好看死了。
exercises.explainEn: No 非常 before ……死了; say 这个电影好看死了.

exercises.q: I'm terribly hungry.
exercises.body: I'm terribly hungry.

exercises.q: It's so cold!
exercises.body: It's so cold!

exercises.q: He is extremely busy.
exercises.body: He is extremely busy.

points.note: 夸张口语，“死了”通常不是字面死亡；可修饰正面或负面感受。
points.source: Discover China Student's Book Four (用户上传教材): Language in use
points.structureEn: Adjective / Feeling Verb + 死了 (sǐ le, extremely)
points.noteEn: This is a colloquial exaggeration: 死了 usually has nothing to do with real death, and it can follow both good and bad feelings.

points.name: 要是/如果……就好了（愿望）
points.explainEn: Use 要是/如果…就好了 to say 'it would be great if…'.
points.structure: 要是/如果 + 想象的情况，就好了

examples.zh: 要是明天不下雨就好了。
examples.en: It would be great if it did not rain tomorrow.
examples.py: Yàoshi míngtiān bú xià yǔ jiù hǎo le.

examples.zh: 如果我有更多时间就好了。
examples.en: I wish I had more time.
examples.py: Rúguǒ wǒ yǒu gèng duō shíjiān jiù hǎo le.

examples.en: It would be great if you could come.
examples.py: Yàoshi nǐ néng lái jiù hǎo le.

exercises.q: 我的钱包丢了，___早点儿发现就好了。
exercises.body: 我的钱包丢了，___早点儿发现就好了。
exercises.explain: “要是……就好了”表示希望或遗憾；“即使、虽然、因为”都不能跟“就好了”构成愿望。
exercises.explainEn: 要是……就好了 expresses a wish or regret; 即使, 虽然 and 因为 cannot form a wish with 就好了.

exercises.q: 要是我会说中文就好了，___。
exercises.body: 要是我会说中文就好了，___。
options: 所以我常常跟中国人聊天
exercises.explain: “要是……就好了”表示愿望，说的是现在还不是这样的情况，所以后面说“可惜我一句也不会”。
exercises.explainEn: 要是…就好了 is a wish about something not true now, so it goes on with "unfortunately I can't speak a word".

exercises.q: 下面哪一句有错？
exercises.body: 下面哪一句有错？
options: 如果我能早点儿知道就好了。
要是我有时间就好了去旅游。
要是你也在这儿就好了。
要是今天不上班就好了。
exercises.explain: “就好了”要放在句子最后：要是我有时间去旅游就好了。
exercises.explainEn: 就好了 goes at the very end: 要是我有时间去旅游就好了.

exercises.q: If only I could speak Chinese better.
exercises.a: 要是我的中文能说得更好就好了。
exercises.body: If only I could speak Chinese better.

exercises.q: It would be great if tomorrow were a holiday.
exercises.body: It would be great if tomorrow were a holiday.

exercises.q: I wish I could go with you.
exercises.a: 要是我能跟你一起去就好了。
exercises.body: I wish I could go with you.

points.note: 表达主观愿望，不是普通条件复句的事实判断。
points.source: Discover China Student's Book Four (用户上传教材): Language in use
points.structureEn: 要是 (yàoshi, if) / 如果 (rúguǒ, if) + Wish, 就好了 (jiù hǎo le, it would be great)
points.noteEn: It expresses a personal wish, not a statement of fact like an ordinary "if…, then…" sentence.

points.name: 可（加强语气）
points.explainEn: Use 可 in speech to make a statement stronger: 'really / indeed'.
points.structure: 主语 + 可 + 动词短语/形容词（+了）

examples.en: This is really great!
examples.py: Zhè kě tài hǎo le!

examples.en: You really must not forget.
examples.py: Nǐ kě bié wàng le.

examples.en: He is really serious.
examples.py: Tā kě rènzhēn le.

exercises.q: 明天的考试很重要，你___别迟到啊！
exercises.body: 明天的考试很重要，你___别迟到啊！
exercises.explain: “可”加强语气，常用在“可别……”里提醒别人。
exercises.explainEn: 可 adds emphasis and is common in 可别…… warnings.

exercises.q: 这个地方的菜可___了！
exercises.body: 这个地方的菜可___了！
exercises.explain: “可＋形容词＋了”，中间只放形容词，不加“很”或补语。
exercises.explainEn: 可 + adj + 了 takes a bare adjective, no 很 or complement.

exercises.q: 下面哪一句有错？
exercises.body: 下面哪一句有错？
options: 你可来了，我们等了你半天。
exercises.explain: “可”本身就加强程度，不能再加“很”：他可聪明了。
exercises.explainEn: 可 already intensifies, so drop 很: 他可聪明了.

exercises.q: You really mustn't be late!
exercises.body: You really mustn't be late!

exercises.q: This is really important.
exercises.body: This is really important.

exercises.q: He is really good at Chinese.
exercises.body: He is really good at Chinese.

points.note: 口语中通过“可”加强肯定、提醒或惊讶，不能一律译为can。
points.source: Discover China Student's Book Four (用户上传教材): Language in use
points.structureEn: Subject + 可 (kě, really / indeed) + Verb Phrase / Adjective (+ 了 le)
points.noteEn: In speech, 可 makes a statement, a reminder or a surprise stronger. Don't always translate it as "can".

points.name: 反正（理由/态度）
points.explainEn: Use 反正 to mean 'anyway'. The speaker thinks the result or decision is the same.
points.structure: 反正 + 原因/结论 + 后续态度

examples.zh: 反正明天放假，我们可以晚一点儿起床。
examples.en: Tomorrow's a holiday anyway, so we can get up a bit later.
examples.py: Fǎnzhèng míngtiān fàngjià, wǒmen kěyǐ wǎn yìdiǎnr qǐchuáng.

examples.zh: 我不去，反正我也不喜欢。
examples.en: I won't go; I don't like it anyway.
examples.py: Wǒ bú qù, fǎnzhèng wǒ yě bù xǐhuan.

examples.zh: 反正你已经来了，就一起吃饭吧。
examples.en: Since you're here anyway, let's eat together.
examples.py: Fǎnzhèng nǐ yǐjīng lái le, jiù yìqǐ chī fàn ba.

exercises.q: 你别着急，___我们还有时间，慢慢来。
exercises.body: 你别着急，___我们还有时间，慢慢来。
exercises.explain: “反正”给出理由，表示不管怎样情况都一样；“反而”表示跟预料相反。
exercises.explainEn: 反正 gives a reason that makes the rest not matter; 反而 means 'on the contrary'.

exercises.q: 不管你同不同意，反正___。
exercises.body: 不管你同不同意，反正___。
exercises.explain: “反正”表示不管情况怎样，结论都不变，所以是“我已经决定了”；“听你的、由你决定”跟“不管你同不同意”矛盾。
exercises.explainEn: 反正 means the conclusion stays the same whatever happens, so "I've already decided"; leaving it to you clashes with "whether you agree or not".

exercises.q: 下面哪一句有错？
exercises.body: 下面哪一句有错？
options: 他学习很努力，反正成绩不太好。
你别买了，反正家里还有很多。
反正我也没事，就陪你去吧。
不管你怎么说，反正我不去。
exercises.explain: 这里是转折，不是理由，应该用“可是”：他学习很努力，可是成绩不太好。
exercises.explainEn: This is a contrast, not a reason; use 可是 instead of 反正.

exercises.q: I have time today anyway, so I'll go with you.
exercises.a: 反正我今天有时间，我陪你去吧。
exercises.body: I have time today anyway, so I'll go with you.

exercises.q: We're already late anyway, so don't rush.
exercises.a: 反正已经晚了，别着急了。
exercises.body: We're already late anyway, so don't rush.

exercises.q: It's not expensive anyway, so just buy it.
exercises.a: 反正这个不贵，你就买吧。
exercises.body: It's not expensive anyway, so just buy it.

points.note: 可在句首或分句开头出现；表达“无论怎样，态度不变”。
points.source: Discover China Student's Book Four (用户上传教材): Language in use
points.structureEn: 反正 (fǎnzhèng, anyway) + Reason / Judgment, + Decision
points.noteEn: 反正 can come at the start of a sentence or of a clause. It means "whatever happens, my view stays the same".

points.name: 怎么（表示“怎么会/怎么回事”）
points.explainEn: Use 怎么 to ask 'how come / why', often with surprise.
points.structure: 主语 + 怎么 + 动词/形容词 + 了/呢？

examples.en: How come you have not left yet?
examples.py: Nǐ zěnme hái méi zǒu?

examples.en: Why did he get angry?
examples.py: Tā zěnme shēngqì le?

examples.en: How come you are so tired?
examples.py: Nǐ zěnme zhème lèi?

exercises.q: 都十点了，你___还不起床？
exercises.body: 都十点了，你___还不起床？
exercises.explain: “怎么”放在动词前表示奇怪、意外；“怎样、怎么样”问方式或情况，不能这样用。
exercises.explainEn: 怎么 before a verb shows surprise ("how come"); 怎样/怎么样 ask about manner or condition and can't be used here.

exercises.q: 你怎么___？大家都在等你。
exercises.body: 你怎么___？大家都在等你。
exercises.explain: 表示奇怪、不满的“怎么”问已经发生的事，比如“怎么现在才来”；不能跟“吗”或正反问一起用。
exercises.explainEn: 怎么 (how come) asks about something that has happened, e.g. 怎么现在才来; it can't take 吗 or an A-not-A question.

exercises.q: 下面哪一句有错？
exercises.body: 下面哪一句有错？
exercises.explain: 有了疑问词“怎么”，句末不能再用“吗”：你怎么去了北京？
exercises.explainEn: With the question word 怎么, do not add 吗: 你怎么去了北京？

exercises.q: How come you are late?
exercises.body: How come you are late?

exercises.q: Why isn't he here yet?
exercises.body: Why isn't he here yet?

exercises.q: How come this is so expensive?
exercises.body: How come this is so expensive?

points.note: 这里不是询问方法的“怎么做”，而是带惊讶语气的原因问句。
points.source: Discover China Student's Book Four (用户上传教材): Language in use
points.structureEn: Subject + 怎么 (zěnme, how come) + Verb / Adjective (+ 了 le / 呢 ne)?
points.noteEn: This is not 怎么 asking how to do something (怎么做); it asks "why / how come", with a tone of surprise.

points.name: 到底/究竟（加强追问）
points.explainEn: Use 到底 or 究竟 in a question to ask 'exactly / after all'.
points.structure: 主语 + 到底/究竟 + 疑问词/问句？

examples.en: Where exactly do you want to go?
examples.py: Nǐ dàodǐ xiǎng qù nǎr?

examples.en: What exactly happened?
examples.py: Zhè jiūjìng shì zěnme huí shì?

examples.en: Is he coming or not, after all?
examples.py: Tā dàodǐ lái bu lái?

exercises.q: 你说了半天，___想不想去啊？
exercises.body: 你说了半天，___想不想去啊？
exercises.explain: “到底”用在问句里加强追问；“终于、最后、已经”说的是事情的结果或状态，不能用来追问。
exercises.explainEn: 到底 presses for an answer in a question; 终于, 最后 and 已经 describe an outcome or state and cannot press a question.

exercises.q: 这件事你到底___？
exercises.body: 这件事你到底___？
exercises.explain: “到底”要跟正反问或疑问词一起用，不能跟“吗、吧”。
exercises.explainEn: 到底 goes with an A-not-A or question-word question, not 吗 or 吧.

exercises.q: 下面哪一句有错？
exercises.body: 下面哪一句有错？
exercises.explain: “到底”不跟“吗”一起用，应说：你到底是不是学生？
exercises.explainEn: 到底 does not go with 吗; say 你到底是不是学生？

exercises.q: What exactly do you mean?
exercises.body: What exactly do you mean?

exercises.q: When exactly will the meeting start?
exercises.a: 会议究竟什么时候开始？
exercises.body: When exactly will the meeting start?

exercises.q: Where on earth is my phone?
exercises.body: Where on earth is my phone?

points.note: “究竟”较正式；“到底”口语常见，两者都加强提问语气。
points.source: Discover China Student's Book Four (用户上传教材): Language in use
points.structureEn: Subject + 到底 (dàodǐ) / 究竟 (jiūjìng, exactly) + Question?
points.noteEn: 究竟 is more formal; 到底 is common in everyday speech. Both make a question more insistent.

points.name: 不过/只不过/只是……罢了（弱化情况）
points.explainEn: Use 不过/只是…罢了 to mean 'only / merely', making something seem less important.
points.structure: 主语 + 不过/只不过/只是 + 动词/名词 + 罢了

examples.en: I was only asking.
examples.py: Wǒ zhǐshì wènwen bàle.

examples.zh: 这不过是个小问题罢了。
examples.en: This is only a small problem.
examples.py: Zhè búguò shì ge xiǎo wèntí bàle.

examples.zh: 他不过是开个玩笑罢了。
examples.en: He was only joking.
examples.py: Tā búguò shì kāi ge wánxiào bàle.

exercises.q: 别担心，我___是有点儿累罢了。
exercises.body: 别担心，我___是有点儿累罢了。
exercises.explain: “只是……罢了”表示事情不严重；“可是、还是”意思不对。
exercises.explainEn: 只是……罢了 means 'it's only…'; 可是 and 还是 do not fit.

exercises.q: 你别担心，这不过是___罢了。
exercises.body: 你别担心，这不过是___罢了。
exercises.explain: “不过……罢了”把事情说得很小、不严重，所以是“一次小考试”。
exercises.explainEn: 不过…罢了 plays something down, so "just a small quiz".

exercises.q: 下面哪一句有错？
exercises.body: 下面哪一句有错？
options: 他只是不想去罢了，没有别的意思。
他只不过比我大两岁罢了。
这只不过是一场小雨罢了。
这件事很重要罢了，你一定要记住。
exercises.explain: “罢了”把事情说小，跟“很重要”矛盾，应去掉：这件事很重要，你一定要记住。
exercises.explainEn: 罢了 downplays and clashes with 很重要; drop it.

exercises.q: I only want to help.
exercises.body: I only want to help.

exercises.q: It's just a misunderstanding.
exercises.body: It's just a misunderstanding.

exercises.q: It was only a small mistake.
exercises.a: 这只不过是一个小错误罢了。
exercises.body: It was only a small mistake.

points.note: 教材标题把“不过/只不过/只是……罢了”作为弱化表达；避免与表示转折的“不过”混淆。
points.source: Discover China Student's Book Four (用户上传教材): Language in use
points.structureEn: Subject + 不过 (búguò, merely) / 只不过 (zhǐ búguò, only) / 只是 (zhǐshì, just) + Verb / Noun + 罢了 (bàle, that's all)
points.noteEn: The textbook groups 不过 / 只不过 / 只是……罢了 as ways to play something down ("only, that's all"). Don't confuse this with 不过 meaning "but".

points.name: 不但/不只/不仅/不光……而且/还/也……
points.pinyin: búdàn / bùzhǐ / bùjǐn / bùguāng ... érqiě / hái / yě ...
points.explainEn: Use this pattern to mean 'not only…, but also…'.
points.structure: 不但/不只/不仅/不光 + A，而且/还/也 + B

examples.zh: 她不仅会中文，还会英语。
examples.en: She speaks not only Chinese but also English.
examples.py: Tā bùjǐn huì Zhōngwén, hái huì Yīngyǔ.

examples.zh: 这个工作不但有意思，而且很重要。
examples.en: This job is not only interesting but also important.
examples.py: Zhège gōngzuò búdàn yǒu yìsi, érqiě hěn zhòngyào.

examples.zh: 他不光帮了我，还给了我建议。
examples.en: He not only helped me but also gave me advice.
examples.py: Tā bùguāng bāng le wǒ, hái gěi le wǒ jiànyì.

exercises.q: 他不但会说中文，___会说日语。
exercises.body: 他不但会说中文，___会说日语。
exercises.explain: “不但”后面用“而且/还/也”表示更进一步；“但是”表示转折。
exercises.explainEn: 不但 is followed by 而且/还/也 to add more; 但是 marks a contrast.

exercises.q: 这家饭馆不仅菜好吃，而且___。
exercises.body: 这家饭馆不仅菜好吃，而且___。
exercises.explain: “不仅……而且……”前后意思要同一个方向，都是好的方面。
exercises.explainEn: 不仅……而且…… links points in the same direction, here both positive.

exercises.q: 下面哪一句有错？
exercises.body: 下面哪一句有错？
options: 不仅我喜欢这本书，我的朋友也喜欢。
不但他会说中文，而且会说日语。
这家店的东西不但便宜，而且质量很好。
她不光会唱歌，还会跳舞。
exercises.explain: 前后主语相同时，“不但”放在主语后面：他不但会说中文，而且会说日语。
exercises.explainEn: With one subject, 不但 goes after it: 他不但会说中文……

exercises.q: She is not only kind but also patient.
exercises.a: 她不但善良，而且有耐心。
exercises.body: She is not only kind but also patient.

exercises.q: This hotel is not only clean but also cheap.
exercises.a: 这家酒店不仅干净，而且便宜。
exercises.body: This hotel is not only clean but also cheap.

exercises.q: He not only studies but also works.
exercises.body: He not only studies but also works.

points.note: 第二分句还可用“还/也/而且”，不用每次都用“而且”。
points.source: Discover China Student's Book Four (用户上传教材): Language in use
points.structureEn: 不但 (búdàn) / 不只 (bùzhǐ) / 不仅 (bùjǐn) / 不光 (bùguāng, not only) + A, 而且 (érqiě) / 还 (hái) / 也 (yě, but also) + B
points.noteEn: The second part can also use 还 or 也 — you don't have to use 而且 every time.

points.name: 后来和然后
points.explainEn: 后来 means 'later' in a story. 然后 means 'then' between steps or events.
points.structure: 过去情况 + 后来 + 变化；动作1，然后 + 动作2

examples.zh: 我以前住北京，后来搬到了上海。
examples.en: I used to live in Beijing and later moved to Shanghai.
examples.py: Wǒ yǐqián zhù Běijīng, hòulái bān dào le Shànghǎi.

examples.en: First buy the ticket, then enter the station.
examples.py: Xiān mǎi piào, ránhòu jìn zhàn.

examples.zh: 我们先吃饭，然后去看电影。
examples.en: We will eat first and then see a movie.
examples.py: Wǒmen xiān chī fàn, ránhòu qù kàn diànyǐng.

exercises.q: 我们毕业以后就没联系了，___的事我就不知道了。
exercises.body: 我们毕业以后就没联系了，___的事我就不知道了。
exercises.explain: “后来”是时间名词，可以说“后来的事”；“然后、接着、再”只能连接动作，不能放在“的”前面。
exercises.explainEn: 后来 is a time noun, so 后来的事 works; 然后/接着/再 only link actions and can't take 的.

exercises.q: 你先在这儿坐一会儿，然后___。
exercises.body: 你先在这儿坐一会儿，然后___。
exercises.explain: “然后”可以连接将来的两个动作，这里是安排，所以是“再一起去吃饭”；“后来”只说过去。
exercises.explainEn: 然后 can link two future actions; this is a plan, so "then we'll go eat together"; 后来 is only for the past.

exercises.q: 下面哪一句有错？
exercises.body: 下面哪一句有错？
options: 我们先去银行，然后去超市。
我以前不喜欢吃辣的，后来喜欢上了。
他去年去了上海，后来又去了广州。
exercises.explain: “后来”只说过去，这里是将来的动作顺序，要用“然后”：你先洗手，然后再吃饭。
exercises.explainEn: 后来 is only for the past; a future sequence needs 然后.

exercises.q: He was a student; later he became a teacher.
exercises.a: 他以前是学生，后来当了老师。
exercises.body: He was a student; later he became a teacher.

exercises.q: First wash your hands, then eat.
exercises.body: First wash your hands, then eat.

exercises.q: I went to the shop, then went home.
exercises.a: 我先去了商店，然后回家了。
exercises.body: I went to the shop, then went home.

points.note: 后来侧重过去时间的推进；然后可以说明过去、现在或未来的一系列步骤。
points.source: Discover China Student's Book Four (用户上传教材): Language in use
points.structureEn: Past Situation + 后来 (hòulái, later) + Change; Action 1 + 然后 (ránhòu, then) + Action 2
points.noteEn: 后来 is about time moving on in the past; 然后 can link a series of steps in the past, present or future.

points.name: 无论/不论/不管……都……
points.explainEn: Use it to mean 'no matter what/how/whether…, always…'.
points.structure: 无论/不论/不管 + 情况/疑问词，都 + 不变的结果

examples.zh: 无论天气怎么样，我都去。
examples.en: No matter what the weather is like, I will go.
examples.py: Wúlùn tiānqì zěnmeyàng, wǒ dōu qù.

examples.en: No matter who comes, we welcome them.
examples.py: Bùguǎn shéi lái, wǒmen dōu huānyíng.

examples.zh: 不论多忙，他都坚持运动。
examples.en: No matter how busy he is, he keeps exercising.
examples.py: Búlùn duō máng, tā dōu jiānchí yùndòng.

exercises.q: ___明天下不下雨，我们都要出发。
exercises.body: ___明天下不下雨，我们都要出发。
exercises.explain: “下不下雨”是正反问的形式，只能跟“无论/不管”配合，表示什么情况都一样。
exercises.explainEn: An A-not-A phrase like 下不下雨 only works with 无论/不管 (whatever happens).

exercises.q: 不管工作多忙，他___。
exercises.body: 不管工作多忙，他___。
exercises.explain: “不管……”后面要用“都”说出不变的结果。
exercises.explainEn: 不管…… needs 都 with an unchanging result.

exercises.q: 下面哪一句有错？
exercises.body: 下面哪一句有错？
options: 不管你去哪儿，我都跟着你。
不论天气怎么样，比赛都会进行。
无论天气很冷，他都去游泳。
无论谁问我，我都这么说。
exercises.explain: “无论”后面要用疑问词或正反形式，不能是确定的情况：无论天气多冷，他都去游泳。
exercises.explainEn: 无论 needs a question word or A-not-A, not a fixed fact: 无论天气多冷……

exercises.q: No matter where you go, I will help you.
exercises.a: 无论你去哪儿，我都会帮你。
exercises.body: No matter where you go, I will help you.

exercises.q: No matter how hard it is, I will try.
exercises.body: No matter how hard it is, I will try.

exercises.q: No matter what he says, I won't change my mind.
exercises.a: 不论他说什么，我都不会改变主意。
exercises.body: No matter what he says, I won't change my mind.

points.note: 三个词语体略有差别，“不论/无论”偏正式，结果句常用“都/也”。
points.source: Discover China Student's Book Four (用户上传教材): Language in use
points.structureEn: 无论 (wúlùn) / 不论 (búlùn) / 不管 (bùguǎn, no matter) + Condition, 都 (dōu, still/always) + Result
points.noteEn: The three words differ a little in style: 不论 and 无论 are more formal. The result part usually uses 都 or 也.

points.name: 原来/果然/竟然（语气副词）
points.explainEn: 原来 means 'so that's it / it turns out'; 果然 means 'as expected'; 竟然 means 'unexpectedly'.
points.structure: 原来 + 新发现；果然 + 符合预期的事实；竟然 + 出乎意料的事实

examples.en: So you live here too!
examples.py: Yuánlái nǐ yě zhù zài zhèlǐ.

examples.zh: 天气预报说会下雨，果然下雨了。
examples.en: The forecast said it would rain, and it did.
examples.py: Tiānqì yùbào shuō huì xià yǔ, guǒrán xià yǔ le.

examples.zh: 他竟然忘了自己的生日。
examples.en: Surprisingly, he forgot his own birthday.
examples.py: Tā jìngrán wàng le zìjǐ de shēngrì.

exercises.q: 我早就觉得他会迟到，他___迟到了。
exercises.body: 我早就觉得他会迟到，他___迟到了。
exercises.explain: 事情跟预料的一样用“果然”；“竟然、居然”表示出乎意料。
exercises.explainEn: 果然 = as expected; 竟然/居然 mean unexpectedly.

exercises.q: 我找了半天手机，原来___。
exercises.body: 我找了半天手机，原来___。
exercises.explain: “原来”表示发现了以前不知道的真实情况：手机原来就在包里。
exercises.explainEn: 原来 shows you have discovered the real situation: the phone was in my bag all along.

exercises.q: 下面哪一句有错？
exercises.body: 下面哪一句有错？
options: 我以为他不会来，他果然来了。
他说今天会下雨，果然下雨了。
这么简单的题，他竟然做错了。
exercises.explain: 跟原来想的相反，要用“竟然”：我以为他不会来，他竟然来了。
exercises.explainEn: When it turns out opposite to what you thought, use 竟然: 我以为他不会来，他竟然来了。

exercises.q: So this is your book!
exercises.body: So this is your book!

exercises.q: As expected, he passed the exam.
exercises.body: As expected, he passed the exam.

exercises.q: Surprisingly, she can speak Chinese.
exercises.body: Surprisingly, she can speak Chinese.

points.note: 三者不是同义词；情境分别为新发现、符合预期、出乎意料。
points.source: Discover China Student's Book Four (用户上传教材): Language in use
points.structureEn: 原来 (yuánlái, it turns out) + Discovery; 果然 (guǒrán, as expected) + Result; 竟然 (jìngrán, surprisingly) + Unexpected Result
points.noteEn: These three are not synonyms. Use them for a new discovery (原来), something that matches what you expected (果然), and something unexpected (竟然).

points.name: 算（是）（个人评价）
points.explainEn: Use 算(是) to mean 'can be considered / count as' when giving an opinion.
points.structure: 人/事 + 算（是）+ 名词/形容词评价

examples.en: This counts as a good way to do it.
examples.py: Zhè suànshì ge hǎo bànfǎ.

examples.en: His Chinese is quite good, all things considered.
examples.py: Tā de Zhōngwén suàn búcuò le.

examples.zh: 这里算是比较安静的地方。
examples.en: This can be considered a fairly quiet place.
examples.py: Zhèlǐ suànshì bǐjiào ānjìng de dìfang.

exercises.q: 他的中文虽然不是最好的，但在我们班___不错的。
exercises.body: 他的中文虽然不是最好的，但在我们班___不错的。
exercises.explain: “算是”表示从某个角度评价；“认为、以为、觉得”前面要有人作主语。
exercises.explainEn: 算是 gives an evaluation; 认为/以为/觉得 need a person as subject.

exercises.q: 来北京三年了，我也算是___了。
exercises.body: 来北京三年了，我也算是___了。
exercises.explain: “算是”是对自己的评价，住了三年可以说是半个北京人。
exercises.explainEn: 算是 is a self-evaluation: after three years you count as half a Beijinger.

exercises.q: 下面哪一句有错？
exercises.body: 下面哪一句有错？
options: 今天的考试算比较简单。
exercises.explain: “算是”用来评价，不能说计划，应说：我打算明天去上海。
exercises.explainEn: 算是 evaluates; for a plan say 我打算明天去上海.

exercises.q: He can be considered a good teacher.
exercises.body: He can be considered a good teacher.

exercises.q: This is a pretty good result, all things considered.
exercises.body: This is a pretty good result, all things considered.

exercises.q: We can count this as a success.
exercises.body: We can count this as a success.

points.note: “是”可以省略，表达主观评估或相对标准，不是绝对身份判定。
points.source: Discover China Student's Book Four (用户上传教材): Language in use
points.structureEn: Person / Thing + 算(是) (suàn shì, can be considered) + Noun / Judgment
points.noteEn: 是 can be left out. It gives a personal or relative judgment, not a statement of what something definitely is.

points.name: 看起来（似乎/看来）
points.explainEn: Use 看起来 to say what something seems like from what you see: 'looks / seems'.
points.structure: 主语 + 看起来 + 形容词/判断

examples.en: You look tired.
examples.py: Nǐ kàn qǐlai hěn lèi.

examples.en: This restaurant looks good.
examples.py: Zhè jiā fànguǎn kàn qǐlai búcuò.

examples.en: He looks younger than last year.
examples.py: Tā kàn qǐlai bǐ qùnián niánqīng.

exercises.q: 这个菜___很好吃，我们点一个吧。
exercises.body: 这个菜___很好吃，我们点一个吧。
exercises.explain: “看起来”表示从外表判断；“看出来”是看后发现、认出，“看见”只是看到。
exercises.explainEn: 看起来 means judging by appearance; 看出来 means to tell or recognize, and 看见 just means to see.

exercises.q: 他看起来___，其实已经四十岁了。
exercises.body: 他看起来___，其实已经四十岁了。
exercises.explain: “看起来……其实……”表示外表跟真实情况相反，他看着比实际年轻。
exercises.explainEn: 看起来……其实…… contrasts looks with reality: he looks younger than he is.

exercises.q: 下面哪一句有错？
exercises.body: 下面哪一句有错？
options: 我看起来这本书很有意思。
exercises.explain: “看起来”的主语是被判断的事物，不是说话人：这本书看起来很有意思（或：我觉得……）。
exercises.explainEn: The subject of 看起来 is the thing judged: 这本书看起来很有意思.

exercises.q: She looks very happy.
exercises.body: She looks very happy.

exercises.q: This place looks beautiful.
exercises.body: This place looks beautiful.

exercises.q: The problem seems difficult.
exercises.body: The problem seems difficult.

points.note: 是根据外观获得的印象，不一定是客观事实；与“看见”不同。
points.source: Discover China Student's Book Four (用户上传教材): Language in use
points.structureEn: Subject + 看起来 (kàn qǐlái, looks/seems) + Adjective / Judgment
points.noteEn: It is an impression based on how something looks, not necessarily a fact. It is different from 看见 ("to see").

points.name: 差点儿（几乎发生）
points.explainEn: Use 差点儿 to mean 'almost / nearly', for something that almost happened.
points.structure: 主语 + 差点儿 + 动词/动词短语 +（了）

examples.en: I was almost late.
examples.py: Wǒ chàdiǎnr chídào le.

examples.en: He almost fell.
examples.py: Tā chàdiǎnr shuāidǎo.

examples.en: We almost forgot the tickets.
examples.py: Wǒmen chàdiǎnr wàng le dài piào.

exercises.q: 路上堵车，我___没赶上飞机。
exercises.body: 路上堵车，我___没赶上飞机。
exercises.explain: “差点儿没赶上”表示几乎没赶上，最后赶上了；“有点儿、一点儿”没有这个意思。
exercises.explainEn: 差点儿没赶上 = almost missed (but made it); 有点儿 and 一点儿 cannot mean 'almost'.

exercises.q: 今天早上我差点儿___，还好妈妈叫我了。
exercises.body: 今天早上我差点儿___，还好妈妈叫我了。
exercises.explain: “差点儿”说几乎发生但没发生的事，妈妈叫了我，所以没有起晚。
exercises.explainEn: 差点儿 is for something that nearly happened; Mom woke me, so I didn't oversleep.

exercises.q: 下面哪一句有错？
exercises.body: 下面哪一句有错？
options: 今天我差点儿迟到了，晚了十分钟。
我们差点儿没赶上火车。
exercises.explain: “差点儿迟到”是没迟到，后面却说晚了十分钟，矛盾，应说：今天我迟到了，晚了十分钟。
exercises.explainEn: 差点儿迟到 means not late, but 'ten minutes late' contradicts it; say 今天我迟到了.

exercises.q: I almost missed the bus.
exercises.a: 我差点儿错过了公交车。
exercises.body: I almost missed the bus.

exercises.q: She almost cried.
exercises.body: She almost cried.

exercises.q: I almost forgot your name.
exercises.a: 我差点儿忘了你的名字。
exercises.body: I almost forgot your name.

points.note: “差点儿”有时结合否定形式表达反预期结果，教学时应同时给出明确语境；英译练习以易辨认情况为主。
points.source: Discover China Student's Book Four (用户上传教材): Language in use
points.structureEn: Subject + 差点儿 (chàdiǎnr, almost) + Verb / Verb Phrase (+ 了 le)
points.noteEn: 差点儿 is sometimes used with a negative word (差点儿没……), and the meaning then depends on the situation, so it needs clear context. The translation practice sticks to the easier cases.

points.name: 多……啊（感叹）
points.explainEn: Use 多 + adjective + 啊 to show strong feeling: 'how…!'.
points.structure: 主语 + 多 + 形容词 + 啊！

examples.en: How beautiful the scenery is!
examples.py: Zhèlǐ de fēngjǐng duō měi a!

examples.en: How lovely this child is!
examples.py: Zhège háizi duō kě'ài a!

examples.en: How nice the weather is today!
examples.py: Jīntiān de tiānqì duō hǎo a!

exercises.q: 你看，这些花___漂亮啊！
exercises.body: 你看，这些花___漂亮啊！
exercises.explain: 感叹时用“多＋形容词＋啊”；“太”要跟“了”配合。
exercises.explainEn: An exclamation uses 多 + adj + 啊; 太 needs 了.

exercises.q: 要是能每天睡到十点，那该多___啊！
exercises.body: 要是能每天睡到十点，那该多___啊！
exercises.explain: “多……啊”中间只放形容词，不加“了、很、的”。
exercises.explainEn: 多……啊 takes a bare adjective, without 了, 很 or 的.

exercises.q: 下面哪一句有错？
exercises.body: 下面哪一句有错？
exercises.explain: “多”已经表示程度，不能再加“很”：今天多热啊！
exercises.explainEn: 多 already shows degree, so drop 很: 今天多热啊！

exercises.q: How delicious this food is!
exercises.body: How delicious this food is!

exercises.q: How happy she is!
exercises.body: How happy she is!

exercises.q: How tall this building is!
exercises.body: How tall this building is!

points.note: 这是感叹程度的“多”，不是询问数量的“多少”。
points.source: Discover China Student's Book Four (用户上传教材): Language in use
points.structureEn: Subject + 多 (duō, how) + Adjective + 啊 (a)!
points.noteEn: This 多 shows strong feeling ("how…!"). It is not the 多 of 多少 that asks about quantity.

points.name: 是否（是不是，书面）
points.explainEn: Use 是否 to mean 'whether or not', often in formal Chinese.
points.structure: 主语 + 是否 + 动词/形容词/小句

examples.en: I do not know whether he will come.
examples.py: Wǒ bù zhīdào tā shìfǒu huì lái.

examples.en: May I ask whether you agree?
examples.py: Qǐngwèn nǐ shìfǒu tóngyì?

examples.zh: 我们还没决定是否参加。
examples.en: We have not decided whether to join.
examples.py: Wǒmen hái méi juédìng shìfǒu cānjiā.

exercises.q: 请问您___是这所大学的学生？
exercises.body: 请问您___是这所大学的学生？
exercises.explain: “是否”可以放在“是”前面，说“是否是”；“是不是是”重复了，“有没有、可不可以”不跟“是”搭配。
exercises.explainEn: 是否 can go before 是 (是否是…); 是不是是 repeats 是, and 有没有/可不可以 don't go with 是.

exercises.q: 我们还不知道他是否___。
exercises.body: 我们还不知道他是否___。
exercises.explain: “是否”本身就有正反两面，后面不能再用正反问或“吗”。
exercises.explainEn: 是否 already means "whether or not", so it can't be followed by an A-not-A question or 吗.

exercises.q: 下面哪一句有错？
exercises.body: 下面哪一句有错？
options: 我不知道这家店是否还开门。
我不知道他是否已经回国了。
exercises.explain: “是否”已经表示疑问，不能再加“吗”：你是否是中国人？
exercises.explainEn: 是否 already asks the question, so drop 吗.

exercises.q: I don't know whether she is free.
exercises.body: I don't know whether she is free.

exercises.q: We are discussing whether to go.
exercises.body: We are discussing whether to go.

exercises.q: Please confirm whether the time is suitable.
exercises.body: Please confirm whether the time is suitable.

points.note: 常用于书面和正式提问，不能与“是不是”在所有语境中完全互换。
points.source: Discover China Student's Book Four (用户上传教材): Language in use
points.structureEn: Subject + 是否 (shìfǒu, whether or not) + Verb / Adjective / Clause
points.noteEn: 是否 is mostly used in writing and formal questions. It cannot replace 是不是 in every situation.

lessons.title: 这个题目是不是太大了？

points.name: 动词来动词去（反复）
points.explainEn: Use Verb + 来 + Verb + 去 to show repeating an action again and again.
points.structure: 动词 + 来 + 同一动词 + 去 +（结果/评价）

examples.zh: 我想来想去，还是决定去。
examples.en: I thought it over and over and decided to go.
examples.py: Wǒ xiǎng lái xiǎng qù, háishi juédìng qù.

examples.zh: 他看来看去，没找到喜欢的。
examples.en: He looked again and again but found nothing he liked.
examples.py: Tā kàn lái kàn qù, méi zhǎodào xǐhuan de.

examples.zh: 我们讨论来讨论去，也没结果。
examples.en: We discussed it repeatedly but reached no result.
examples.py: Wǒmen tǎolùn lái tǎolùn qù, yě méi jiéguǒ.

exercises.q: 他紧张得在房间里___，一刻也停不下来。
exercises.body: 他紧张得在房间里___，一刻也停不下来。
exercises.explain: “动词＋来＋动词＋去”表示动作反复进行，正合“一刻也停不下来”；“走一走”是短时、轻松地走，“走过去”“走出来”只说一次移动的方向。
exercises.explainEn: V来V去 means doing it back and forth over and over — matching 'couldn't stop for a moment'. 走一走 is a short, relaxed walk; 走过去 / 走出来 describe a single movement in one direction.

exercises.q: 他找来找去，___。
exercises.body: 他找来找去，___。
exercises.explain: “找来找去”表示找了很多次，跟“一下子、马上、很快”矛盾。
exercises.explainEn: 找来找去 means searching again and again, which clashes with 'at once' or 'quickly'.

exercises.q: 下面哪一句有错？
exercises.body: 下面哪一句有错？
options: 我挑来挑去，最后买了一件红色的。
他们商量来商量去，还是决定坐火车去。
孩子们在公园里跑来跑去。
exercises.explain: “看来看去”后面不能带宾语和“了”，应说：这本书我看来看去，……
exercises.explainEn: 看来看去 takes no object or 了 after it; say 这本书我看来看去……

exercises.q: She searched everywhere but didn't find it.
exercises.a: 她找来找去，还是没找到。
exercises.body: She searched everywhere but didn't find it.

exercises.q: I thought it over and over but still couldn't decide.
exercises.a: 我想来想去，还是不能决定。
exercises.body: I thought it over and over but still couldn't decide.

exercises.q: He walked back and forth.
exercises.body: He walked back and forth.

points.note: “来/去”在此不表示真实朝向，而是重复或往返动作。
points.source: Discover China Student's Book Four (用户上传教材): Language in use
points.structureEn: Verb + 来 (lái) + Same Verb + 去 (qù) + (Result), meaning 'back and forth'
points.noteEn: Here 来 and 去 don't show a real direction; they show an action repeated again and again, or back and forth.

points.name: 下去（动作继续）
points.explainEn: Use 下去 after a verb to show that the action continues.
points.structure: 动词 + 下去；否定：动词 + 不 + 下去

examples.en: Please keep talking.
examples.py: Qǐng jìxù shuō xiàqu.

examples.en: We need to keep going.
examples.py: Wǒmen yào jiānchí xiàqu.

examples.zh: 这个故事太长了，我听不下去了。
examples.en: This story is too long; I cannot keep listening.
examples.py: Zhège gùshi tài cháng le, wǒ tīng bu xiàqu le.

exercises.q: 这个电影太没意思了，我实在看不___了。
exercises.body: 这个电影太没意思了，我实在看不___了。
exercises.explain: “看不下去”表示没办法继续看了；“看不出来”是看不出、发现不了。
exercises.explainEn: 看不下去 means you can't go on watching; 看不出来 means you can't tell by looking.

exercises.q: 你再这样___下去，身体会受不了的。
exercises.body: 你再这样___下去，身体会受不了的。
exercises.explain: “下去”表示动作继续，前面要是能一直持续的事，比如“天天加班”；“加了一天班、昨天加班”已经结束了。
exercises.explainEn: 下去 means "keep on", so it needs an ongoing activity like working overtime every day, not a finished one-off.

exercises.q: 下面哪一句有错？
exercises.body: 下面哪一句有错？
options: 你说得很好，请继续说下去。
他停下去，回头看了看我。
学中文很难，可是我会坚持下去。
这么热的天，我实在走不下去了。
exercises.explain: “停”要用“下来”：他停下来，回头看了看我。
exercises.explainEn: 停 takes 下来: 他停下来……

exercises.q: I want to keep studying.
exercises.body: I want to keep studying.

exercises.q: Please go on reading.
exercises.body: Please go on reading.

exercises.q: I can't keep working like this.
exercises.a: 我不能这样工作下去了。
exercises.body: I can't keep working like this.

points.note: 引申为动作持续，不是空间向下的趋向。
points.source: Discover China Student's Book Four (用户上传教材): Language in use
points.structureEn: Verb + 下去 (xiàqù, keep going); Negative: Verb + 不 + 下去 (cannot continue)
points.noteEn: Here 下去 means an action continues; it is not about moving downward.

points.name: 把……花/用/浪费在……上
points.pinyin: bǎ ... huā / yòng / làngfèi zài ... shàng
points.explainEn: Use this pattern to say where you spend your time, money, or energy.
points.structure: 主语 + 把 + 时间/金钱/精力 + 花/用/浪费 + 在 + 事情 + 上

examples.zh: 我把很多时间花在学习中文上。
examples.en: I spend a lot of time studying Chinese.
examples.py: Wǒ bǎ hěn duō shíjiān huā zài xuéxí Zhōngwén shang.

examples.zh: 不要把钱浪费在没用的东西上。
examples.en: Do not waste money on useless things.
examples.py: Bú yào bǎ qián làngfèi zài méi yòng de dōngxi shang.

examples.zh: 她把精力都用在工作上了。
examples.en: She put all her energy into work.
examples.py: Tā bǎ jīnglì dōu yòng zài gōngzuò shang le.

exercises.q: 他把所有的钱都___在买书上了。
exercises.body: 他把所有的钱都___在买书上了。
exercises.explain: “把钱花在……上”是固定搭配，“买、给、付”不能这样用。
exercises.explainEn: 把钱花在……上 is the set pattern; 买, 给 and 付 do not fit it.

exercises.q: 他把工资都浪费在___上了。
exercises.body: 他把工资都浪费在___上了。
exercises.explain: “浪费在……上”指把钱花在没用的事上；给妈妈买礼物、交房租、孩子的学习都是有用的。
exercises.explainEn: 浪费在…上 means spending on something useless; gifts for Mom, rent and a child's education are all useful.

exercises.q: 下面哪一句有错？
exercises.body: 下面哪一句有错？
options: 我把周末都花在了学中文上。
他把一个月的工资都花在了衣服上。
不要把时间浪费在不重要的事情上。
他把很多钱花在买游戏。
exercises.explain: “花在……上”不能少“上”：他把很多钱花在买游戏上。
exercises.explainEn: 花在…上 needs 上: 他把很多钱花在买游戏上.

exercises.q: He spends money on books.
exercises.body: He spends money on books.

exercises.q: I spend a lot of time on exercise.
exercises.a: 我把很多时间花在运动上。
exercises.body: I spend a lot of time on exercise.

exercises.q: Don't waste your time on games.
exercises.a: 别把时间浪费在游戏上。
exercises.body: Don't waste your time on games.

points.note: 把的宾语是可支配资源；不要把“花在……上”误认为空间动作。
points.source: Discover China Student's Book Four (用户上传教材): Language in use
points.structureEn: Subject + 把 (bǎ) + Time/Money/Energy + 花 (huā, spend) / 用 (yòng, use) / 浪费 (làngfèi, waste) + 在 (zài) + Activity + 上 (shàng)
points.noteEn: The object of 把 here is something you can use up, like time, money or energy. 花在……上 is not a physical movement.

points.name: 即使……也……（让步）
points.explainEn: Use 即使…也… to mean 'even if…, still…'.
points.structure: 即使 + 不利/假设情况，也 + 结果/态度

examples.en: Even if it rains, I will go.
examples.py: Jíshǐ xià yǔ, wǒ yě yào qù.

examples.zh: 即使很忙，他也会给妈妈打电话。
examples.en: Even when busy, he calls his mom.
examples.py: Jíshǐ hěn máng, tā yě huì gěi māma dǎ diànhuà.

examples.zh: 即使失败了，也不要放弃。
examples.en: Even if you fail, do not give up.
examples.py: Jíshǐ shībài le, yě bú yào fàngqì.

exercises.q: ___明天下大雨，我也要去爬山。
exercises.body: ___明天下大雨，我也要去爬山。
exercises.explain: “即使……也……”表示假设，就算下大雨也不改变；“只要”后面用“就”，“既然”说已知事实。
exercises.explainEn: 即使…也… means "even if"; 只要 pairs with 就, and 既然 states a known fact.

exercises.q: 即使你不喜欢这个工作，___。
exercises.body: 即使你不喜欢这个工作，___。
exercises.explain: “即使”后面要用“也”说不变的结果。
exercises.explainEn: 即使 needs 也 with an unchanged result.

exercises.q: 下面哪一句有错？
exercises.body: 下面哪一句有错？
options: 即使很累，他也坚持跑步。
即使他已经来了，就让他进来吧。
exercises.explain: 已经是事实，后面又用“就”，应该用“既然”：既然他已经来了，就让他进来吧。
exercises.explainEn: It is already a fact and is followed by 就, so use 既然.

exercises.q: Even if it's cold, I will go out.
exercises.a: 即使天气很冷，我也会出去。
exercises.body: Even if it's cold, I will go out.

exercises.q: Even if I'm tired, I will finish it.
exercises.body: Even if I'm tired, I will finish it.

exercises.q: Even if it's expensive, she wants to buy it.
exercises.body: Even if it's expensive, she wants to buy it.

points.note: 前句提出条件，后句行动或判断仍不改变。
points.source: Discover China Student's Book Four (用户上传教材): Language in use
points.structureEn: 即使 (jíshǐ, even if) + Condition, 也 (yě, still) + Result
points.noteEn: The first part gives a condition; the action or judgment in the second part still doesn't change.

points.name: 想……就……（随意选择）
points.explainEn: Use 想…就… to mean 'do whatever/whenever you want'.
points.structure: 主语 + 想 + 什么/去哪儿/做什么 + 就 + 相同疑问词/动作

examples.en: Eat whatever you like.
examples.py: Nǐ xiǎng chī shénme jiù chī shénme.

examples.zh: 我们想去哪儿就去哪儿。
examples.en: We can go wherever we want.
examples.py: Wǒmen xiǎng qù nǎr jiù qù nǎr.

examples.zh: 她想什么时候休息就什么时候休息。
examples.en: She rests whenever she wants.
examples.py: Tā xiǎng shénme shíhou xiūxi jiù shénme shíhou xiūxi.

exercises.q: 周末你想几点起床___几点起床。
exercises.body: 周末你想几点起床___几点起床。
exercises.explain: “想……就……”表示随意，前后用同一个疑问词。
exercises.explainEn: 想……就…… means 'whatever you like', with the same question word twice.

exercises.q: 这儿的衣服你想买哪件就___。
exercises.body: 这儿的衣服你想买哪件就___。
exercises.explain: “想……就……”前后要用同一个疑问词，前面是“哪件”，后面也是“哪件”。
exercises.explainEn: The same question word must repeat: 哪件……哪件.

exercises.q: 下面哪一句有错？
exercises.body: 下面哪一句有错？
options: 他想什么时候来就什么时候来。
exercises.explain: 前后疑问词要一样：你想看什么就看什么。
exercises.explainEn: The question words must match: 想看什么就看什么.

exercises.q: Do whatever you want.
exercises.body: Do whatever you want.

exercises.q: Drink whatever you like.
exercises.body: Drink whatever you like.

exercises.q: Go whenever you want.
exercises.a: 你想什么时候去就什么时候去。
exercises.body: Go whenever you want.

points.note: 教材强调前后疑问词对应，表示自由选择；两个主语可以相同也可以不同。
points.source: Discover China Student's Book Four (用户上传教材): Language in use
points.structureEn: Subject + 想 (xiǎng, want) + Choice, 就 (jiù, then) + Same Choice/Action
points.noteEn: The textbook stresses that the question words in both parts match, which shows free choice. The two subjects can be the same or different.

points.name: 动词1着 + 动词2（动作方式）
points.explainEn: Use Verb 1 + 着 + Verb 2 when the first action is the way or state of doing the second.
points.structure: 主语 + 动词1 + 着 +（宾语1）+ 动词2 +（宾语2）

examples.en: She speaks while smiling.
examples.py: Tā xiào zhe shuōhuà.

examples.en: He eats while standing.
examples.py: Tā zhàn zhe chī fàn.

examples.en: The child goes to school carrying a schoolbag.
examples.py: Háizi bēi zhe shūbāo shàngxué.

exercises.q: 别___看书，对眼睛不好。
exercises.body: 别___看书，对眼睛不好。
exercises.explain: “动词1＋着＋动词2”表示用什么方式做，所以是“躺着看书”。
exercises.explainEn: Verb1 + 着 + verb2 shows the manner, so 躺着看书.

exercises.q: 他笑着___。
exercises.body: 他笑着___。
exercises.explain: “V1着”后面要接另一个具体动作，表示用这种方式做这件事。
exercises.explainEn: V1着 must be followed by another concrete action done in that manner.

exercises.q: 下面哪一句有错？
exercises.body: 下面哪一句有错？
options: 孩子们唱着歌走进了教室。
exercises.explain: “着”后面不能再加“了”：他站着跟我说话。
exercises.explainEn: No 了 after 着: 他站着跟我说话.

exercises.q: He listens to music while lying down.
exercises.body: He listens to music while lying down.

exercises.q: She came in smiling.
exercises.body: She came in smiling.

exercises.q: He came in holding a book.
exercises.body: He came in holding a book.

points.note: 动词1着往往说明动词2发生时的姿势或方式；不是单纯表示两个独立动作。
points.source: Discover China Student's Book Four (用户上传教材): Language in use
points.structureEn: Subject + Verb 1 + 着 (zhe, while/in this manner) + (Object 1) + Verb 2 + (Object 2)
points.noteEn: Verb 1 + 着 usually describes the posture or manner in which Verb 2 happens; it is not just two separate actions.

points.name: 之所以……是因为……（原因强调）
points.explainEn: Use 之所以…是因为… to explain and emphasize the reason.
points.structure: 主语 + 之所以 + 结果，是因为 + 原因

examples.zh: 我之所以迟到，是因为堵车。
examples.en: The reason I was late is that there was traffic.
examples.py: Wǒ zhīsuǒyǐ chídào, shì yīnwèi dǔchē.

examples.zh: 他之所以学习中文，是因为喜欢中国文化。
examples.en: He studies Chinese because he likes Chinese culture.
examples.py: Tā zhīsuǒyǐ xuéxí Zhōngwén, shì yīnwèi xǐhuan Zhōngguó wénhuà.

examples.zh: 我们之所以没去，是因为下雨了。
examples.en: We didn't go because it rained.
examples.py: Wǒmen zhīsuǒyǐ méi qù, shì yīnwèi xià yǔ le.

exercises.q: 我___选择这家公司，是因为这里的人很好。
exercises.body: 我___选择这家公司，是因为这里的人很好。
exercises.explain: 前面是结果、后面“是因为”说原因，前面要用“之所以”；“因此”表示结果，不能跟“是因为”配合。
exercises.explainEn: When the second clause gives the reason with 是因为, the first needs 之所以; 因此 marks a result and can't pair with 是因为.

exercises.q: 他之所以学习这么努力，___。
exercises.body: 他之所以学习这么努力，___。
exercises.explain: “之所以”后面必须用“是因为”说出原因。
exercises.explainEn: 之所以 must be followed by 是因为 giving the reason.

exercises.q: 下面哪一句有错？
exercises.body: 下面哪一句有错？
options: 这个地方之所以有名，是因为这里的风景很美。
他之所以没来，是因为生病了。
之所以下雨，所以比赛取消了。
我之所以喜欢这座城市，是因为这里很安静。
exercises.explain: “之所以”后面是结果，不是原因，应说：因为下雨，所以比赛取消了。
exercises.explainEn: 之所以 introduces a result, not a cause; say 因为下雨，所以比赛取消了.

exercises.q: The reason she is tired is that she worked all day.
exercises.a: 她之所以累，是因为工作了一整天。
exercises.body: The reason she is tired is that she worked all day.

exercises.q: The reason I called is that I need help.
exercises.a: 我之所以打电话，是因为需要帮助。
exercises.body: The reason I called is that I need help.

exercises.q: The reason we are happy is that we passed the exam.
exercises.a: 我们之所以高兴，是因为通过了考试。
exercises.body: The reason we are happy is that we passed the exam.

points.note: “之所以”引出结果，“是因为”后说明原因；不要颠倒其逻辑关系。
points.source: Discover China Student's Book Four (用户上传教材): Language in use
points.structureEn: Subject + 之所以 (zhī suǒyǐ, the reason why) + Result, 是因为 (shì yīnwèi, is because) + Reason
points.noteEn: 之所以 introduces the result, and 是因为 is followed by the reason. Don't reverse them.

points.name: 以A为B（将A当作B）
points.explainEn: Use 以 A 为 B to mean 'take/use A as B'. It is formal.
points.structure: 主语 + 以 + A + 为 + B

examples.en: We take Beijing as the starting point.
examples.py: Wǒmen yǐ Běijīng wéi qǐdiǎn.

examples.zh: 这次活动以环保为主题。
examples.en: This event takes environmental protection as its theme.
examples.py: Zhè cì huódòng yǐ huánbǎo wéi zhǔtí.

examples.en: The school puts students at the center.
examples.py: Xuéxiào yǐ xuésheng wéi zhōngxīn.

exercises.q: 这次旅行我们___上海为第一站。
exercises.body: 这次旅行我们___上海为第一站。
exercises.explain: 固定格式是“以A为B”，把A当作B；“把”要说“把……作为”。
exercises.explainEn: The set pattern is 以A为B; 把 would need 把……作为.

exercises.q: 这家饭馆的菜以___为主。
exercises.body: 这家饭馆的菜以___为主。
exercises.explain: “以……为主”中间要放名词，说明主要是什么。
exercises.explainEn: 以……为主 takes a noun saying what is the main part.

exercises.q: 下面哪一句有错？
exercises.body: 下面哪一句有错？
options: 我们以这家饭馆为见面地点。
我们以这座山为目标，今天一定要爬上去。
exercises.explain: “以”和“为”要分开，中间放A：我们以北京为第一站。
exercises.explainEn: 以 and 为 must be split with A in between: 以北京为第一站.

exercises.q: We use English as the main language.
exercises.a: 我们以英语为主要语言。
exercises.body: We use English as the main language.

exercises.q: This class takes travel as its topic.
exercises.body: This class takes travel as its topic.

exercises.q: We put safety first.
exercises.body: We put safety first.

points.note: 教材区分“以……为……”（当作）与“以……为标准”（参照）；要看B的具体含义。
points.source: Discover China Student's Book Four (用户上传教材): Language in use
points.structureEn: Subject + 以 (yǐ, take) + A + 为 (wéi, as) + B
points.noteEn: The textbook separates 以……为…… ("take A as B") from 以……为标准 ("use A as the standard"). Look at what B actually means.

points.name: 才……呢（加强语气）
points.explainEn: Use 才…呢 to argue back or correct someone: 'X is the one that…' or 'no way…!'.
points.structure: 主语 + 才 + 动词/形容词 + 呢

examples.en: You're the one who's really right!
examples.py: Nǐ cái shuō de duì ne!

examples.en: Now this is really good!
examples.py: Zhè cái hǎo ne!

examples.en: He certainly isn't afraid!
examples.py: Tā cái bú pà ne!

exercises.q: A：你怕不怕狗？B：我___不怕呢！
exercises.body: A：你怕不怕狗？B：我___不怕呢！
exercises.explain: “才……呢”加强语气，表示坚决否定对方的想法。
exercises.explainEn: 才……呢 adds emphasis, firmly rejecting the other person's idea.

exercises.q: A：这件衣服太贵了吧？B：一百块钱才___呢！
exercises.body: A：这件衣服太贵了吧？B：一百块钱才___呢！
exercises.explain: B在反驳A，“才……呢”强调相反的看法，所以是“才不贵呢”。
exercises.explainEn: B is contradicting A, so 才……呢 stresses the opposite: 才不贵呢.

exercises.q: 下面哪一句有错？
exercises.body: 下面哪一句有错？
exercises.explain: “才……”的强调句句末用“呢”，不用“吗”：我才不喜欢吃苹果呢！
exercises.explainEn: Emphatic 才 ends with 呢, not 吗.

exercises.q: I really don't want to go!
exercises.body: I really don't want to go!

exercises.q: This one isn't expensive — that one is the expensive one!
exercises.body: This one isn't expensive — that one is the expensive one!

exercises.q: He doesn't know — she's the one who knows the answer!
exercises.a: 他不知道，她才知道答案呢！
exercises.body: He doesn't know — she's the one who knows the answer!

points.note: 常用于反驳、更正或强调对方预期之外的事实，语气应根据语境选择。
points.source: Discover China Student's Book Four (用户上传教材): Language in use
points.structureEn: Subject + 才 (cái, 'is the one that…' / 'no way') + Verb/Adjective + 呢 (ne)
