points.noteEn: It is often used to argue back, correct someone, or stress a fact the other person didn't expect. Choose the tone to fit the situation.

points.name: 何必……呢（不必如此）
points.explainEn: Use 何必…呢 to say 'why bother…?' when something is unnecessary.
points.structure: 何必 + 动词/动词短语 + 呢？

examples.zh: 这么小的事，何必生气呢？
examples.en: Why get angry over such a small matter?
examples.py: Zhème xiǎo de shì, hébì shēngqì ne?

examples.zh: 我们已经知道了，何必再问呢？
examples.en: We already know; why ask again?
examples.py: Wǒmen yǐjīng zhīdào le, hébì zài wèn ne?

examples.zh: 天气这么好，何必待在家里呢？
examples.en: The weather is so nice; why stay at home?
examples.py: Tiānqì zhème hǎo, hébì dāi zài jiā li ne?

exercises.q: 只是一点儿小事，你___这么生气呢？
exercises.body: 只是一点儿小事，你___这么生气呢？
exercises.explain: “何必……呢”是反问，表示没必要；“不必、不用”不用在反问句里。
exercises.explainEn: 何必……呢 is rhetorical ('why bother'); 不必 and 不用 are not used in rhetorical questions.

exercises.q: ___，何必再买一个新的呢？
exercises.body: ___，何必再买一个新的呢？
exercises.explain: “何必……呢”表示没有必要，前面要给出不必做的理由：手机还能用。
exercises.explainEn: 何必…呢 means "there's no need", so the first part gives a reason not to: the phone still works.

exercises.q: 下面哪一句有错？
exercises.body: 下面哪一句有错？
options: 你何必为这点儿小事难过呢？
我们走着去就行，何必坐出租车呢？
他已经知道错了，何必再说他呢？
exercises.explain: “何必”句末用“呢”，不用“吗”：你何必这么着急呢？
exercises.explainEn: 何必 ends with 呢, not 吗.

exercises.q: Why worry so much?
exercises.body: Why worry so much?

exercises.q: Why spend so much money?
exercises.body: Why spend so much money?

exercises.q: Why argue about this?
exercises.body: Why argue about this?

points.note: 反问句表达不赞成或认为没有必要，不是真正询问原因。
points.source: Discover China Student's Book Four (用户上传教材): Language in use
points.structureEn: 何必 (hébì, why bother) + Verb / Verb Phrase + 呢 (ne)?
points.noteEn: This is a rhetorical question: it shows you disagree or think something is unnecessary. It is not really asking for a reason.

points.name: 别说A，就是B也/都……（让步列举）
points.pinyin: biéshuō A, jiùshì B yě / dōu ...
points.explainEn: Use 别说 A，就是 B 都… to mean 'let alone A; even B…'.
points.structure: 别说 + 较难/极端情况，就是 + 较简单情况 + 也/都 + 谓语

examples.zh: 别说跑十公里了，就是跑一公里我也累。
examples.en: Never mind ten kilometers — even one kilometer makes me tired.
examples.py: Biéshuō pǎo shí gōnglǐ le, jiùshì pǎo yì gōnglǐ wǒ yě lèi.

examples.zh: 别说买房了，就是房租也很贵。
examples.en: Never mind buying a home — even rent is expensive.
examples.py: Biéshuō mǎi fáng le, jiùshì fángzū yě hěn guì.

examples.zh: 别说孩子了，就是大人也不明白。
examples.en: Never mind children — even adults don't understand.
examples.py: Biéshuō háizi le, jiùshì dàren yě bù míngbai.

exercises.q: 别说一千块了，___一百块我也没有。
exercises.body: 别说一千块了，___一百块我也没有。
exercises.explain: “别说A，就是B也……”，B是更容易的情况，用“就是”引出。
exercises.explainEn: In 别说A，就是B也……, 就是 brings in the easier case B.

exercises.q: 这个字太难了，别说外国学生，就是___。
exercises.body: 这个字太难了，别说外国学生，就是___。
exercises.explain: “就是”后面应该是最不可能出问题的人，字很难，连中国人都不一定认识。
exercises.explainEn: 就是 introduces the least likely case: even Chinese people may not know such a hard character.

exercises.q: 下面哪一句有错？
exercises.body: 下面哪一句有错？
options: 别说出国了，就是去北京我也没去过。
我太累了，别说跑步，就是走路也不想走。
别说一公里，就是十公里我也跑不了。
这件事别说他了，就是老师也不知道。
exercises.explain: “别说”后面应是更难的，“就是”后面是更容易的：别说十公里，就是一公里我也跑不了。
exercises.explainEn: 别说 takes the harder case and 就是 the easier: 别说十公里，就是一公里……

exercises.q: Never mind speaking Chinese — I can't even read it.
exercises.a: 别说说中文了，就是看中文我也不会。
exercises.body: Never mind speaking Chinese — I can't even read it.

exercises.q: Never mind a new car — even an old car is expensive.
exercises.a: 别说新车了，就是旧车也很贵。
exercises.body: Never mind a new car — even an old car is expensive.

exercises.q: Never mind an hour — I don't even have ten minutes.
exercises.a: 别说一个小时了，就是十分钟我也没有。
exercises.body: Never mind an hour — I don't even have ten minutes.

points.note: 强调连较低条件都达不到；A与B需要构成强弱对比。
points.source: Discover China Student's Book Four (用户上传教材): Language in use
points.structureEn: 别说 (biéshuō, let alone) + Harder Case A, 就是 (jiùshì, even) + Easier Case B + 也/都 (yě/dōu) + Result
points.noteEn: It stresses that even the easier case B doesn't work out, so A is out of the question. A and B need to be a clear "harder vs. easier" pair.

points.name: 一直/不断（持续或反复）
points.explainEn: 一直 means 'all along / continuously'; 不断 means 'repeatedly / keep on'.
points.structure: 主语 + 一直 + 动词/状态；主语 + 不断 + 动词/变化

examples.en: I have been studying Chinese all along.
examples.py: Wǒ yìzhí zài xuéxí Zhōngwén.

examples.en: He keeps asking questions.
examples.py: Tā búduàn wèn wèntí.

examples.en: The company keeps improving its service.
examples.py: Gōngsī búduàn gǎijìn fúwù.

exercises.q: 他___住在上海，没搬过家。
exercises.body: 他___住在上海，没搬过家。
exercises.explain: “一直”表示状态持续不变；“不断”表示动作反复或变化不停，不能说“不断住”；“常常、往往”说的是经常发生的事，跟“没搬过家”不配。
exercises.explainEn: 一直 is for an unbroken state; 不断 is for repeated actions or ongoing change; 常常/往往 are for things that happen often, which clashes with never having moved.

exercises.q: 这几年，他的中文水平不断___。
exercises.body: 这几年，他的中文水平不断___。
exercises.explain: “不断”后面跟表示变化的动词，不能跟形容词。
exercises.explainEn: 不断 is followed by a verb of change, not an adjective.

exercises.q: 下面哪一句有错？
exercises.body: 下面哪一句有错？
options: 他不断是我最好的朋友。
这几年，来这儿旅游的人不断增加。
最近的天气一直不太好。
exercises.explain: “是”表示状态，要用“一直”：他一直是我最好的朋友。
exercises.explainEn: 是 describes a state, so use 一直.

exercises.q: She has always supported me.
exercises.body: She has always supported me.

exercises.q: We keep learning new things.
exercises.body: We keep learning new things.

exercises.q: He has been waiting here.
exercises.body: He has been waiting here.

points.note: “一直”强调时间连续，“不断”常强调动作多次或发展持续。
points.source: Discover China Student's Book Four (用户上传教材): Language in use
points.structureEn: Subject + 一直 (yìzhí, continuously) + Verb/State; Subject + 不断 (búduàn, again and again) + Verb/Change
points.noteEn: 一直 stresses that something goes on without a break; 不断 often stresses an action happening again and again, or steady change.
